MS 4.5 – pp. 150-216

MS 5.1 – pp. 1-45

The notes of the year 1880 started on February 23, upon her return from Rome, where Mother Rosa stayed since the early days of the same month. The “tunnels” which infused fear in her, were those of the Florence – Bologna railway. In the eternal city she had been received in audience by Leo XIII. From 20 of March to April 5, we find her again in Rome. Then she travelled to Naples where she remained for about a month. A long stay of three months in Piacenza followed from mid-May until the end of August. They were days of bitter suffering during which she gave vent with her supreme Good. After another journey in Rome, she visited some houses of north Italy and ended the year with a second journey to Naples.

Certain pages of the Memorie of 1880 denote moments of unease in the responsibility Mother Rosa faced as a Foundress. Indeed it was in 1880 that among some groups of sisters a climate of unhappiness was manifested regarding her style of governance accused of being too personal. The Cardinal Protector intervened to convince her to modify her “too much secrecy” when it would be better to keep her immediate collaborators informed. She was doing it but only to respect what she kept secretly in her intimate relationships with the Sisters. There were also other slanderous accusations. The most annoying was that of blaming her for directing the money of the Work for her children.

In this situation, in certain moments she experienced much tiredness under the weight of the responsibilities; she saw signs of nearness of her death. The idea of being free from the office of the Superior General emerged too, which afterwards she will verify as coming from the tempter.

However, days of interior peace, of ineffable union with the supreme Good, where she received courage and light to face the difficulties are not missing, though she felt so much alone. After a confession to a holy priest, who seemed to read her soul, she wrote: “How precious to have a good spiritual director, who is wise in certain moments!”

MS 4.5 – pp. 150 150-216

Absorption in God and ecstatic union

Date 23 February 1880. How much encouragement my Beloved gave me this morning in my thanksgiving of Holy Communion with his union! Through this I remained so absorbed in him and I was assured on many things which worried me a bit. After this union I remained so calm that I do not know how to express the joy I had. Really all this came unexpectedly because I was very arid and upset for fear of being in sin and of having || lost my Good. 151 I would prefer a thousand deaths than to think of having disgusted in the least my God. Oh, Love without limits!

I had a very sweet night, balm to the immense sufferings and pains I underwent through the earlier days…

I had hardly fallen asleep than a shaking woke me. On the wall near me there was a beast with legs similar to a spider. As soon as it realised I wanted to say something it fell down and vanished. It left me sad || and gave me pain thinking what would happen to me. 152 But the mercy of God helped me and relieved me so much that I passed the whole night in ecstasy. In this way united with my Good, I seemed to be very close to him! I shook myself and returned to be united to him through prayer. My Good, my God, my sweet Spouse, my Love, consume me in you and for you.

153 I cannot express what this union of the whole night produced in me: strength, || resignation, and courage in facing suffering torments that I well knew were coming. Luckily I waited for them.

Welcome – I said when they arrived. Oh, my Love!

The help of St. Michael in journey

I will speak of the help I got in my journey from St.

Michael the Archangel. I prepared myself for the pain which I usually feel having to pass even through different tunnels; then my angel appeared to me and said:

Do not fear, I will be your guide and defence, you will not suffer.

154 Oh, my dear guide, do not leave me even for a moment but again promise || to be my guide on the way till I reach my Eternal Father. Lead me there tracing the way I should go to reach him and may the love of my Beloved consume me.

Having said this, my side started being united, my ribs were already raised, I was feeling much pain and I feared being realised. Oh, how much I suffer when I have to make an effort not to be realised! 155 It is a big battle because I want to keep myself in a manner that I am not realised and then

I become very afflicted || and feel pain to turn away from such a sweet union. But I would suffer a thousand deaths rather than that they become aware of something. Oh,

Love, how sweet and painful you are; why can’t I ever be consumed by you?

“Suffering, my companion, you are always sweet to me!”

This evening 9 May 1880, what a pain! I have been accompanied to the room; I stayed for a while in the church, but how can I resist without giving vent to such a strong impulse. I tried as much as I could to turn away. Oh, if I could be alone, what sweetness! 156 Instead I will say that it was bitter night of toil because continually I had to battle with the fear of remaining || absorbed and that they may realise. Jesus my Good, my Love, do not come closer because you kill me!

My side was very swollen or rather my bones rose up and what did I feel? Only you, my Good, could describe it, such was the pain for not being alone. In the midst of earthly things, temporal affairs, crosses and tribulations of every kind, everything is dispelled through 157 the strength of such sweet suffering || because you are the only one that prepares me well for my Beloved.

Therefore suffering, my companion, you are always sweet to me for what you obtain for me.

Joy in thinking of the possibility of a quick death

I will not keep silent regarding the lights that my God gave me in these days on certain very interwoven and painful affairs. It kept me thoughtful, resulting in me a feeling of melancholy, not being able to know what it was and what it meant.

158 I already said other times that every time a Daughter of St. Anne dies a star appears to me; || if she is a good sister, especially a superior, it is a big one, more or less bright. Some days ago a big star appeared to me and it stayed in the air for two good times; the third time that it appeared it beat me on my forehead. I thought and thought within myself and then I said:

Could I be? Full of joy, I could not avoid exclaiming:

My Good, is it true? 159 I would be very happy if || the desired time had come for me! Happy state! Love, will it be true?

And soon I was making a thousand good arrangements and preparations.

Oh, death, if you are so sweet, why do they fear you?

Light on the deplorable state of a community

I felt this was very sweet but at once my sweetness was transformed into bitterness and pains.

In a visit to a house, I found much pretence; in another house it was horrible. 160 As soon as I knelt something pushed me to look at the Holy Mother St. Anne and I saw she was covered with a black veil. I felt as if an arrow were || vibrating in me, a pain that enraptured me for it was mixed with a rapture of love. Beautiful, dear Mother, no, otherwise they see me, no! Oh, you are killing me! What do you have? What is in this house since you are veiled in black? Oh, I cannot bear it, speak to me, I cannot anymore!

I had a strong fear of not being able to stand up. But I forced myself and I stood up.

161 A melancholy, and unrest invaded my mind; I was not able to have peace after having seen the saint in that manner. I went back and wept. ||

Is it because I did it that you are hostile to me? - I said the words haltingly, not being able to speak normally. Are you like this because of me? Tell me! She unveiled herself a bit and I saw her. Oh, are they the weaknesses that reign in this house?

Unfortunately, what a dread! I did not delay to put myself at work and I found such failures of poverty and failure to comply with the Rule that were horrible; grave failures against poverty, the common acts bungled…

162 With the light my God gave me I tried to discover everything and to find a remedy. || Oh, what sweet Love, what a sweet Master you are for me! Here is your ass, who knows nothing if not what you teach her. My Joy, my Love!

From a painful aridity to burning with love

A strong melancholy did not delay to come upon me, as a result of interior suffering. Wherever I turned I did not find a relief; in addition the fear of not being in God’s grace invaded me; a thousand painful deaths but do not hide!

Come tell me that you forgive me! 163 Oh, what a pain and how many examinations! ||

Therefore, I do not know – I went on repeating within myself – Am I damned? Oh, a thousand deaths would be less painful than being in this cruel state. Alas! As I lamented within myself I was feeling something new which I could not understand. In addition all this seemed to have happened because of a certain affair of mine which always upset me and I was never able to understand well if it was God’s will that I do it; therefore I was careful to discern the || will of God.

164 Suddenly everything disappeared and I was so enraptured that I had to struggle much not to let others realise. My side did not reduce at all since it was very swollen. Oh, my ribs torment me! But it was very sweet, I would never want it to cease. Yes, my Good, what pains are those when one fears losing you and finds herself in aridity! Only you could say and know it. Only you can save and take me out from such a painful state. ||

165 Holy Week of much suffering

My God, what a holy week I spent! How much I suffered! And in addition I had to make an unbelievable effort. I was always under the eyes of all and I did not have but the night; I wept much because I was battled from all sides. I did not find rest at all and after having done a lengthy discipline until bleeding I needed to lie down. After some time I woke up and again I disciplined myself, but it was not helpful. I offered penances but all in vain. Within me the torment of not being in the grace of my Love was growing. || 166 A melancholy of death kept me bound, an interior unrest that seemed I would breathe my last from one minute to the next. Oh, what anguish, what tribulations, my God! A symbol was appearing to me now and then, like the sight of a cypress and then I had such an interior melancholy that I did not know how to stand without being realised by anybody. What will be my Good? My God, give me a clue! It is too painful to be under such anxiety! Nothing! || 167 Just today he revealed to me that the death of the Pope was close and his successor would be sweet, all for the Daughters of St. Anne.

Oh, only you my Love could take me out of such a sad situation and give me relief. My God, I certainly fear because I am truly an abyss of infamy.

Devotion to St. Catherine of Genoa. Sister Anne Serafina

168 For a long time in times of great affliction, when I am half-asleep, St. Catherine appears to; now in one way and then in another way.122 She communicates to me something divine that takes me to ecstasy; I feel great things in union || with God in prayer. In this way I always pray to her. I never had this devotion, before except when I received Holy

Communion in her chapel; however, this was many years ago.

This is what happened last night while I was very troubled. I was very drowsy and soon found myself with her first in one way and later in another way but as soon as I started praying to her I immediately felt lifted up. Oh, how I remained for the whole day!

169 With all this I never || decided to pray to her and make particular prayers, but this morning after many caresses and graces I was not able to resist for long. I established special prayers and communions.

My dear Serafina; oh, the love of my Beloved is sweet! In a flash he dissipated all the clouds, I am unable to think to the past anymore. A sweet honey has come down on my soul and seems to fail no more. 170 Yes, dear Serafina, you have experienced it, may I possess it till I am consumed! Oh, Love, how sweet you are! ||

Vision of a cypress: “Is my death nearing?”

Today I would have challenged any kind of suffering.

After my thanksgiving a small cypress tree appeared to me.

What does it mean, my Good? Is it mine? Is it the one you told me should still be planted for me? I did not understand anything. One morning meditating I looked attentively at the picture of a beautiful Madonna. I was very absorbed and again I saw the tree but taller and a bright light seemed to come to rest on the right side of my head. My God, what do you want to tell me? || Is my death nearing? 171 But the peace and perfect calm I enjoyed was such that I disposed myself and I already thought of many small things that I needed to do. That was not enough; for two days some small stars were moving around me and I was persuaded that they were announcing my close death. I felt much pain for not being sure about it. Dear Good, I prefer seeing nothing rather than being in the dark without any explanation. || 172 I beg you, rather deprive me or give me an explanation. It is painful not to know anything. My dear Jesus, be moved by compassion and give me the meaning of those trees!

In journey at the service of the Work

For many days I have not had a minute of time to write. My God, I have been on a journey and under the oppression of work which does not allow me even to do the necessary things. Various small stars move around me these days; sign of death of various sisters.

173 I had to combat || certain thoughts which oppressed me very much with violence. I overcame them with the help of my God who came with his light and assured me that it was a diabolic turmoil.

I was helped much in the decisions I had to make regarding the sisters and superiors. Someone came dressed like a lamb but inside there was the wolf. Oh, Love!

It is difficult to express what I felt for those lively feelings he gave me. || 174 Only that my side had risen to such a point that alas, I had to force myself so that nobody would realise.

Love, what are you doing? – I went on lamenting very much when I was alone in my room and I knew I was not heard.

I confess that in the journeys when I had to sleep in a room with another, what a pain! I always controlled myself for fear of crying or lamenting. 175 When I was unable to bear it || I came down and I said:

My God, for pity’s sake let it cease! Otherwise how can

I stand such a strong outburst of love, you are killing me!

Oh, my ribs, my hands and legs! Now, while writing, what I feel! I will say that the spasms of the hands keep me shattered without a moment of relief. They are so strong that the action of the nerves swells and the pain reaches the arm. Oh, Love! To suffer and not to die! 176 Everything is little, my Beloved, though this infamy of humanity moans and twists strongly. All the same || I must be subjected. Oh, the pains I feel!

A Sister freed from a spirit which kept her ill

In these days I have been close to a sick sister who has been carrying a grave infirmity for a long time. When I came close to her, my Good was telling me that this creature had a spirit which made her suffer. The doctors had declared that she had an illness of stone and she could never be healed; perhaps they could have operated and done other very alarming things. My God, what did this evil of hell do? 177 Aware of this I ordered it with all || my strength to leave her, but nobody realised, not even the sick person, because joking I gave her two slaps. I was ordering that evil to leave her and it did.

The pains ceased and she became better. She was able to travel with me and go around on foot and in a coach doing excessive work. But the evil spirit took the form of a real sickness manifesting itself as a real stone sickness to the doctors during the visit! Oh, || who could believe such a fact!

178 Who could say that this was a diabolic act! Those symptoms, the spasms, the acute pains of the abdomen and head accompanied by vomit, were not pretended, because that poor creature was so much destroyed that she aroused pity.

I said nothing; I only spoke to my God. In this way the people || could realise nothing. 179 I promised again to do so and I feared nothing. Oh, who knows which of these serpents are in possession of bodies! It had the courage of staying in this creature so dear to the Lord and who works for him, always ready for everything in honour of his glory. Within me I went on thinking:

Therefore many poor people might be subjected to operations, spasms instead it is the ugly beast. Oh, my Love, chain it up, for charity’s sake. How much slaughter it does! ||

180 The sister was healed; she feels nothing and believes she received the miracle of healing;123 while it was the infernal beast that had to be driven away. Oh, my Good, how good you are and infinitely charitable in giving so much to a miserable creature… Oh, I say nothing because I know well my nothingness and in addition to this my many sins which make me tremble only thinking of them. Alas, what I feel! A base kitchen rag! This filthy monster tries to torment me so much that I cannot bear it anymore. It says:

You are damned! You will come because you cannot be saved!

It then shows || me an 181 abyss of confused things I had done and not confessed. It would need much time to describe everything. But for the mercy of my Beloved the graces I receive every day are without compare. He gives me knowledge which I know too well is not mine. I feel certain things come to my mind which I could never understand; the same is for certain contracts.

Poverty in the houses of the Institute

182 Oh, how pleased I am when poor houses || without payment, are accepted; it seems that in these reigns more peace and providence. Oh, Love, yes, you pour your treasures into them! My Good, your brides must find their nourishment only from you. While I prayed, I saw a face that was near me. I asked who she/he was, but I got nothing;

however, as it left I was serene.

Oh, what my side made me feel in these days! The ribs rose so much that I seemed to be about to breathe my last.

183 On the day of Ascension what I felt! || I had a strong headache, and the union with my God was such that I had to force myself so that they may not realise. My Good! At the end I closed myself in the room and I abandoned myself to him, giving vent to what I was not able to hold in.

My Love – I started to say – I am dying and I cannot stand anymore! Have mercy on me! My ribs… Oh, what a pain, your love!

And I remained absorbed in him.

In ecstasy during the sacramental absolution

It is now long period of time not being absorbed while confessing; therefore, I never thought it could happen to me again. - It is true that I always tried to look in order to distract myself and it went on very well, such that I did not give much attention. Confessing myself to a holy religious, a true servant of God, to whom the Lord had given many gifts especially that of foretelling the future, oh, what happened to me!

184 While I disposed myself to receive the absolution I was caught || in ecstasy. Oh, Love! I tried with all the strength I have but I was not able to release myself. Oh, what a pain!

But my Good whose promises – that nobody should realise anything – never fail, made me soon return to myself and the confessor realised nothing. Oh, what I felt, my Love; only you can know it! That the world may always think I am stupid person and may see nothing.

How much I thanked him and with how much fervour for having taken me out 185 186 of a state in which I could have been discovered by his servant; || though he read inside all, my Good did not allow this to happen with me.

Accused by the Protector Cardinal of much secrecy in the government of the Work. Reason

In the novena of the Holy Spirit, it seemed to me on the third day, while I was sleeping I was awakened by a strong shaking. Oh, on high there was an arm keeping a burning candle, a light that illumined the whole room. I remained dazzled while I looked and after some time it vanished. 187 What does it mean? The arm was the servant of God; || that I knew. The lamp was very meaningful; the lights of my Love which he promised to give me in the many things which I still have to undertake.

I heard a sweet rebuke because I had stopped a bit speaking, even on the smallest things of the Work. This was not pleasing the Lord. I had to force myself to say something – I mean of the Work, not my own things, no never. 188 But I was accused by the Protector of much secrecy || which was not wise because in this way the poor sisters learn nothing. I was obliged to tell everything that happened to those who were close to me in order to instruct them better, telling them what I was doing to do away with the abuse or imperfection or other things which took place.

In this way, though with repulsion, I did it, I could say because of obedience. 189 Oh, when I heard such command, it was very dear to me, because || I had no difficulty to put it into practice. In this way I could say it is finished. Yes, my Good, I will speak no more! To say the truth more than repulsion I saw that I obtained no good; not at all, I got into bad mood.

In the past, when I kept quiet, all thought well of the Daughters of St. Anne, though there were more than one who bombarded me. 190 My silence was good because it did not bring any misunderstanding; nobody knew anything, everything || remained with me.124 Yes, my Love, it is sweet to suffer without comfort, because it is placed in you, Love, and exclaiming like this one could say: tell me, I suffer much alone on the cross; I called for you, but nobody came.

Alone I had to swallow the whole chalice of bitterness without losing a drop; I did not receive even a word of comfort because I did not mention to anybody my painful sufferings. 191 I suffered immensely || and from this I found much consolation. I will always do like this, my Good.

The evil of duplicity in the sisters

I am not able to express what I felt today the eve of the

Holy Spirit. My side has grown and my hands… How much strength the union with my Good, – if I can explain like this – gave me! If I could have been alone! Oh, what a day! But not at all! I had to be careful so that they may not realise and to distract myself because I was almost totally absorbed in my Good and just the thought made me watchful. ||

192 What clarity was given me to see what I was still to do and with whom I should negotiate!

In the same way for the sisters: I was reading their interior weakness so clearly as if I saw them with my eyes.

How much pain I felt when I saw certain things which were not according to the will of my God: failures of poverty and sincerity. Oh, this one…

In seeing the duplicity, what pain I felt! 193 I was feeling so bad that I would have liked to remove that ugly || monster from them even at the cost of my blood. I would have disciplined myself a thousand times.

The free will of a person overcomes the most beautiful interior impulses that could be found. She becomes blind, not being able to reason but acting only with one’s will and pleasure.

She leaves the noble side to be abandoned to the base animal side. 194 How much pain I suffer to see that essence of Love who calls them and almost insists on being listened to and in so unsuitable way he is driven away cruelly. ||

Two remarkable Eucharistic experiences

Yesterday 31 May 1880, I had hardly knelt to receive Holy Communion and said to my Good many things in preparation when there was a strong but not an interior voice – I heard it well with my ears – that said:

Now I come, I come quickly.

At first I thought it was the priest who said that since he was preparing himself, or unfolding the corporal.

What does he say? – I asked myself.

But hearing him for the second time: - I come quickly – my God! The voice came from the tabernacle because I was with my face raised and looking the tabernacle. Oh, what I felt!

195 Beloved Jesus, my sweet Love, || yes, come, I wait for you, I embrace you in your heart, this being no more mine but fully yours; and more so, it is because you well know, that you left me no more… Oh, Love!

I do not say what effects it had on me but it is enough to say that my side was very raised… In this way the whole day I felt the sweetness of his union, such that I always felt enraptured and had to be careful so that they may not realise.

196 In the evening when I lay down || a shaking woke; on high I saw a monstrance with the Venerable. It was very beautiful and from the light which was reflected the ray seemed white. Oh, what it brought to me! My side seemed that it almost… My Love, come my God!

Accused by the Bishop of giving the money of the Institute to her children

5 June 1880: what a terrible day! An acute dagger was fixed on me and I did not know how to fill the wound; I heard from the Bishop that I gave the money of the Institute to my children… Oh, cruel heathen! 197 Certainly the devil could not || guess a more atrocious slander than this. For the conscience that my God gave me out of his mercy, I am afraid of the least offence and I feel cruel torture for his Institute and for the Work of his heart. I would give and

I gave everything I had for the Institute and finally my life itself under a continuous suffering and pains of every kind.

Oh, my Crucifix! 198 He is my only comfort, and I run to deposit my suffering. In an uncontrollable fit, I gave vent to || lamenting because only in him and for him I suffer. How much effort I needed to stop the tears especially when I found myself so much with the sisters and in the church!

I had to force myself so much that I feel very bad.

On the other hand, if I do not want this to happen to me in the church I need to give in or rather to abandon myself a bit to the union with my God. 199 But the fear of being observed and remaining || absorbed makes me fear and in this way the thought comes upon me. My God, what a terror!

In addition the Bishop delved into certain particulars, and much distorted affairs of interest. Oh, Love! The

Bishop was already firm – or at least he seemed to be – in the other slander of the same kind. I revealed with great pain that the cause of the debit balance was the money that my Good provided me with, dear beloved Spouse, and I had always received || immense help from him. 200 Oh, could

I use the holy money for the luxury of my children, as they tell me? No, I could not; it is too dishonest.

201 I became emotionally broken by continuous blows through the years and the continuous sufferings I felt it very much. The humanity is depressed while for the past I could say || a series of continued tribulations were always on my back. In this the ass was bowed down. Oh, yes, this suffering bowed it down to the earth but it was bitter!

There will never be a lament I make that anyone will know, only my guide, only him.

Meanwhile in these days I suffered immensely. Not even to him did I describe my bitter pains.

“I go on studying how I can come out of this office”

202 I do not say what the enemy suggested to me; for it takes advantage and torments me || immensely to a point of saying:

For you there will be no peace…

I go on studying what I can do to come out of this office. I study and this comforts me when in my mind I find a means which seems to be able to help for my dismissal.

203 But I do not pray anymore for this. Truly the traitor rejoices and seems || to say:

I have won! At the end I will be away from this table and I can do something.

Oh, ugly monster! While with much astuteness it tries to remove me, it masks itself to a stupid rag. In any case I cannot but be firm in order to be removed; in this way there will not be fears. Oh, cruelty, how can this be! 204 If I had such a conscience, could I wait until today and could I not do it with my son || and with my daughter? Oh, cruelty without compare, this anguish pierces me to the soul!

Therefore, my Jesus, should I offend you? Oh, I already displease you. Could I have the courage to do more? Oh, it is too much! But at the thought that it was a slander and that I can put it with many other immense sufferings that you sent to me out of your goodness, certainly this is just a comfort.125

Apparition of our Lady of Good Counsel

The evening of 23 June 1880, after sleeping for a quarter of an hour, I was shaken; as soon as I woke up I saw a big beast on high. 205 Oh, after many months that I did not || see it!

I was caught by unrest… My God what does it mean? After a long time I slept and while half-asleep or rather in drowsiness, Our Lady of Good Counsel appeared to me and she sweetly indicated to me with her right hand to come closer to her because she needed to speak to me. When I went closer, she said…

Oh, what I felt! I did not see the time to put into practice what I promised. What will I say of my Communion of the morning, after this dear visit? The union || with my Beloved, side… Oh, my ribs were raised! 206 Oh, sweet union of my Good!

Having finished doing what I promised to my dear mother, I remained consoled! What is not felt in doing the will of God! It is sweet and pleasurable. How stupid human beings who leave the greatest good for a tasteless and obscene good in comparison to the sweetest love!

Absorbed in listening on the union with God and on his love

While I was with a servant of God, he was inspired and started speaking about my death. I wanted to pretend as if there was nothing and discreetly || listened to everything;

207 but when he said that what I would experience depended on the union that I would have with God and I will be… Oh, Love, my side felt something; if I was not careful to distract myself I would remain absorbed. But as soon as I heard that… Oh, my Beloved! I need to control myself always when I hear speaking of God; the same for the reading at the table. If there are books which speak about union with God and of his love, what happens to me! But what do I do? 208 With some || pretext I go away. Yes, my Love, you who are the unchangeable and just, never fail to keep your promises!

Night unrest, cruel pains, ingratitude

On various nights I suffered horribly from the pains in the hands and feet; I do not speak of the side, because it always has a bigger portion and there are other pains in the whole of this pig of my body. But that is not enough; certain shadows which move around the room make me restless, annoyed with myself in a way that I cannot express. 209 I feel very upset without knowing the || reason. What nights! If I was able to take a bit of sleep, I was so upset that I suffered much for it seemed that I was falling and it is 210 worse than when one is awake. In the morning I am hardly able to stay on my feet to go to my Good. I desire so much to receive him and it seems to me I have not received him for centuries. I try to make spiritual communions || which are my only comfort, during the day in the midst of many afflictions and tribulations of every kind especially in these days in which I feel all the weight.

There are moments in which I seem to remain overburdened by the suffering. Oh, cruel pains! Received from whom? Oh, sweet Love, one of your disciples betrayed you with a kiss? What did your sweet heart feel? Oh, these days, I understand it well, dear Saviour! Very many 211 of these deeds are repeated. The melancholy || I feel is such that I do not know what I should do so that they may not realise. I struggle so much that I feel oppressed and I cannot avoid saying that the poor body feels bad, tossed and lashed.

I do not have any side without pains, no! I suffer on all sides. If I write I suffer horribly in the hand and unfortunately it can be seen from the swelling. 212 I feel pain in the arm because of the scars. I must have touched a nerve with the iron points that is why I often feel overwhelmed with pains. || My Love, if they could only please you as a reparation for my enormous sins!

“How precious to be guided by a wise and holy director!”

How precious to have a good and wise director in certain moments! Yes, my God, to be guided by a learned and saintly director, as I had the luck of finding for my confession!

My Jesus! You actually gave me the grace of finding a saint; how well he read my soul! How he was able to find the sufferings of my spirit in its strength and of …

Going around I had found a clever confessor; I said nothing but he told me everything. How comforted I felt!

But patience, Jesus wants this: only once and no more…//

213 (…) Oh, Love, everything is little in comparison to my sins. Oh, my Good!

“My only Good, to live and to die only for you!”

Night of 4 July 1880. I cannot describe how I spent this night. I slept saying:

My Love! I remained so absorbed in him that I cannot speak of having slept but of having been the whole night in paradise, because I was always with my Good. Oh, infinite sweetness!

214 I || went through a grave affliction, in which I felt oppressed, but now it has ended. The earlier night as soon as I was ready to sleep and I wanted it, I slept; but I was immediately awakened. I saw a star with a long tail like a comet, but it had black stains. What meaning it could have, I was unable to know quickly. But a serious affliction soon arrived. It passed for God’s mercy || because I was able to remedy it soon. 215 It was a debt or rather, I was to pay the remaining of a purchase I made. Oh, how good is my Good who sent it to me and I was able to pay.

Oh, my Love, human beings are cruel! Certainly if there was not your arm to sustain us how could we survive? Oh, when I am with him I give vent and I make a thousand excuses. My only Good, Being of my life, to live and to die only for you!

Suffering, you are always sweet to me because you come to me sent by my Jesus. Only from you || I can find my happiness. 216 Whoever does not love to suffer does not know what it contains and it is through this that we can have our every consolation. Every good can be obtained from suffering. Oh, if everybody knew it, everybody would want it in order to receive the true good which is the love of God. Oh, my sweet and beloved Love, you are the only Good! All you, come and love the only Good, the Love, Jesus.

MS pp. 1 – 45

Persecutions and slanders of every kind

3 July 1880.126 Having suffered horribly during the 1 day of the Holy Mother and on the two days that followed, on the third day, since the persecutions were fierce and the slanders of all kinds, this ass could not bear anymore. I had fainted ten times and I believed I would not recover anymore. Oh, atrocious pains, especially when they come from people on high level who have received much good from the Work of the Holy Mother! They are unbelievable torments which could not be described. My God, only you could say it!

2 Suffering awaited me || already because the saint had given me notice. In addition a big beast shook me while I was sleeping and it was very near to me; as I opened my eyes, seeing it I thought it wanted to come upon my face.

But as soon as I was about to pronounce the words to question who it was, it disappeared in the wall.

In the same way the next evening I saw another one come upon me but it disappeared. 3 It left me in a dark sadness; in the morning at || half past three I felt so united to God and I started meditating caught up strongly by the union with my Good, that my ribs … Oh, what I felt!

Finally I went to receive Holy Communion and I remained very absorbed. I saw an abyss of pains that I had to undergo and then other great things that my Good had prepared for me. 4 The sight of the great and beautiful things inebriated me and I was feeling such a consolation that in him, my only Good, I remained absorbed for a long time. || After remaining so united for the whole day, I had to be careful to distract myself; in this way it made me forget the abyss of tribulations that I was to go through.

I did not know where I could be saved, such was the fire that came upon me. I found myself without strength and did not know where I could find refuge. I was without strength to face them; it was only the strength of my Good in which I held myself. 5 Only my God could go ahead and || only in him could I stand. Oh, my Good!

The sin of grumbling

How much I suffered to hear certain things about one of our sisters who complained! Oh, God, whatever is grumbling! A sin which is committed easily and brings much evil. It is so severely punished by God because it displeases him horribly. And what account is it given? How could St. Anne not suffer for her daughter? The evidence she gives me is clear for many times she makes me feel the pain and the aversion that she has because of these things.

Two sisters who left but later regretted their decision

I spent two days in agony and I said:

6 Dear Jesus, what will happen that you make me suffer so much? Where could be the place || where things that displease you take place? Alas, I feel I cannot bear it.

The suffering was so much that I could not stand; I tried to hide but there were moments in which the soul seemed to be cut off from the body. What a pain! I cannot find words to describe it! I always went repeating:

What will happen to me?

What a pain, what a tribulation, what an agony! While I was writing, but always immersed in those thoughts, a voice was heard and said to me:

7 Here is your suffering: The two sisters you waited for

|| instead of coming for the Spiritual Exercises…

I felt like dying; in that instant I tried to be strong and run to the Eternal Father but I did not understand where I was.

Alas, where will they be? A thousand thoughts passed through my mind. I went to the feet of my Jesus and I prayed. I felt some kind of calm and the pain lessened

After some time I was given a letter which said that both of them were in the house of one of them, in the paternal house. I remained serene.

8 The next day a letter of the parish priest which calmed me said that one was weeping bitterly || for her mistake because she was drugged by the other. Both of them regretted what they did and asked for forgiveness.

Raptures and burnings of Love

For two days I did not know where to find relief; my side is swollen because it has such raptures and I find myself united with my Good. Oh, I do not know how I did not die; my ribs rise so much and at night I abandon myself to him. Oh, what I feel!

I cry loudly:

Alas, I am dying!

9 But enraptured in him I do not feel any spasm and || recovered, my God! It seems to me a continuous miracle my Beloved performs to keep me alive that I can make the usual lament: my beloved Good, why you do not keep me with you, in your heart without letting me come back to this earth?

And you my Being, why do I feel you but not see you?

Many times I remained absorbed.

I find the most beautiful sweetness of my dear Beloved but later I find myself still with spasms || and I lament.

10 Though I try, I cannot control myself and I go on saying:

keep me with you always or turn away because I cannot stand.

Today it was painful to stay with people! I did not look forward to anything other than the moment that I can be here in my room! Oh, Love, you are killing me!

Today I did not go even for the benediction, I remained here. It was too much; 11 distracting myself with a thousand thoughts of the Work was not helpful. I do not know where to turn. || My head, it always assails me and I need the whole of my strength to stop it. Oh, what a pain!

Disturbances and unrest during sleep

For several days I have not seen beasts, but this ugly monster torments me in another way: now it stays attached to the door as if there were people and forces the lock to open. It makes the window to shake that it seems to be opening. It is painful because it does not let me sleep and sometimes I am forced to wake up.

12 The other night, when I woke up, I was praying || and I was not able to be serene because it aroused such unrest in me… well I ran to my Crucifix and it soon ceased. Oh, my dear Love! My side soon rose from the union that I felt.

What other pain! 13 Yes, in order to sleep at least for a few hours to have strength to wake up the next day, I have to be as though dead without thinking of anything and without praying. In this way my || poor head seems to take strength and the side remains calm.

But I am not always able to do so, because though I try to stay like this I am enraptured and soon I find myself absorbed. Love! But as I recover, what happens? In the morning I am so worn out that I am not able to stand on my feet; I am as one who has been under lashes. The whole night I lament with my Beloved:

This is what I have been reduced to and how can I work? I have no more strength, || not even for going down to the church!

Oh, how many times I wake up and then I come back to lie down and I see well that until I go down to the church to receive him I will not get strength. 14 Oh, after receiving my Good, he gives me strength to stand and work.

A tribulation caused by a mistake of the superiors

How much I suffer when I see duplicity in a person! In her heart I see deceitful devotion and at the same time a mud of passions in order to cover with the mantle || of religion. 15 Oh, dear Good, my Love, how much pain they bring to your heart!

After I see how they are treated by dear Jesus! I do not suffer much for the sight of a sinner but for such souls.

This morning I spent the whole of my thanksgiving listening to my Beloved who was telling me many nice things and among these he told me that I will have much consolation, so much that I had never experienced before.

Love, you are my only consolation! || 16 In these days the suffering was renewed; a sign of another new tribulation which did not delay to come. I will not say “it happened”

because it came from the superiors and certainly it would not happen if the ugly of hell had not painted black for white, but for the mercy of God everything became clear.

17 Yes, the suffering of this kind is terrible, because Jesus himself had to put to light the truth and I saw many times how much they suffered for having beaten themselves where || there was no motive. After having realised the mistake, they suffered; every thing was allowed by my dear Good. While I was depressed in this way, I collapsed and I had a strong headache. Oh, what I suffered! In that suffering I felt so bad that I was not able to make an act of love. What do I say? This pig became like a trunk! But not!

At the end of the spasm of pain, I became terribly frightened. I tried to distract myself and I did what I could in order not to be overcome || by the tormenting melancholy.

18 For me, what I suffered and what I was preparing to suffer were so much that I had to go to bed; but it was worse because my side started rising. If I was able to abandon myself to the union of God, what I felt! If I started praying vocally, I was always taken to the principal, but taken by the weariness I tried to abandon myself, to be calm without trying to think of anything and repelling the force of union that I felt. 19 In this way my side experienced the usual || but lighter spasm.

When it seemed time to sleep, I felt a whisper and something on my arm; what was it? The usual beast, a small one almost without a body but with long legs not as usual but with three or four fingers. Oh, what I felt!

Infamous beast, boldness of hell, why did you touch me?

Oh, what I felt! I am not able to describe it. I must also say that during 20 the day when I was able to keep my eyes open, rays of lively light || passed by as small lightening or flashes of arrows.

Oh, what does it mean? - I went on asking within myself.

However the nearing of the death of a good superior was certain. Oh, soul dear to God!

Oh, blessed soul, you will certainly pray for me!

Discipline until bleeding on the day of the Stigmata of St. Francis

21 On the night after the appearance of the beasts the suffering continued with new disturbances so strong that I was not able to sleep. In the morning when it was already very clear – the day was a Thursday – and the next day || was the Stigmata of St. Francis.127

Yes, my dear father - I said – I promise to discipline myself until bleeding and I will do it very much.

On Friday evening I tried to excuse myself and I said within me:

If I discipline myself tomorrow I will not be able to leave and I will feel the usual weariness. I had to postpone the journey, so necessary, to another day.

I tried to find many excuses not to do it, and at night I went to bed at half-past eleven. A restlessness took hold of me that did not allow me to rest. I took a book and started reading || but nothing. I had always present the discipline.

22 Finally an hour after midnight, I woke up:

Dear St. Francis, my father, you just want me to do it.

Here I am to satisfy my promise; I hope you will think to send me the strength to work.

In this way I had to do much discipline to let a good amount of blood come out, though it was not as before because I had little. As I finished I threw myself on the bed and I slept. 23 Oh, my Love when || you want one thing from this miserable creature you want it without yielding. Oh, Love!

But the next day in Holy Communion, how many beautiful caresses I had! He gave me much light on certain dilemmas. I was oppressed by many afflictions and it was a struggle with this miserable humanity. It suffered much because it did not surrender to the spirit; I had to struggle much. 24 My Good gave me much strength to keep it bound and the whole day I felt certain raptures || of love that my side rose and my ribs twisted from the pain. My Love, for pity’s sake, that people may not realise!

The rapture was strong and it overcame me and therefore I was forced to retire in the room just for a while to give vent to what I was no longer able to keep hidden.

Oh, Love! I took my Crucifix in my hands and as usual, I placed my head on his side and what I felt! You, my seraphic father St. Francis, || could say it! 25 Your tongue could explain it but not me. I am too miserable to be able to describe it. Yes, my Love, sweet Saviour.

“The person who rests in you will have no other rest than that of love”

In these days I just see small stars, signs that some sisters will die and among these a big one which already came to announce to me that soon a good and holy superior will go to heaven. Oh, what a beautiful death and what a presage of glory so to say, from earth to heaven! 26 Oh, you blessed || for being able to keep so well your vows! Oh, death, I envy you, because soon you will be in his arms and you will see face to face your lover, your and my Beloved. I cannot continue anymore, I interrupt because … Oh Love!

Now it is half past eleven and I am having unrest, an agony that I do not know how to resist. My God, what will happen? Unfortunately I understand that this is a pain which announces something sad. 27 I feel a state of agony. Oh, how much I suffer! My Jesus only he || could describe what I suffer: the thought which moves around here and there, the indescribable pain that it comes to me; where is it? Is it here where I am? Is it in this charitable institution from where a superior departed? Today I have already had much with the mayor; there might still be many more afflictions prepared for me? What an anxiety!

I cannot rest because I had in my head the thought that something worse will happen to me. How much I suffer, my God!

28 What a night of spasm, I cannot describe! || Oh, sweetest heart, fountain of every relief of mine, only in you my soul oppressed by the toil and sufferings, finds relief and life. In you I find my life and all my pains become sweet, in you, volcano of love. The person who rests in you has no other rest but that of love; only in you, yes, I experience everything. 29 From this volcano springs every kind of treasure; how blind is the human being who knows not where the real good lies. || Oh, how much compassion I feel, my God! What good did I do to receive so much benefit from you, your lights and your infinite graces? I am a poor, miserable creature that did nothing other than displease you by offending you. Oh, infinite goodness, what can I do to thank you? Oh, I am a miserable creature unfit for good, capable only of spoiling your Work! With infinite charity you show me the way but I always || find myself outside the track. 30 You know well what I want, what I need most that I scream with my humanity. Stubborn beast that never wants to learn that I am its master and must obey or else… Certainly it does not suit it.

An abyss of tribulations without the least comfort

For twenty days there has been a relentless war that from all sides throws fire. Many were the persecutions of every kind that they did not leave me time to receive all and welcome them. 31 I cannot say how much || this miserable humanity oppressed from every side suffers. At night I have no rest; when it seems that I sleep a diabolic army comes and puts off the lamp. It is heard with a thousand noises. It tries to frighten me but I know well the horrible monster which does not allow me to rest. The pain is such that in the morning I am more tired than when I went to bed. Oh, how I agonise! 32 Now it seems to me that I am abandoned || by my God; at last, in a word during the day, sufferings of every kind, those of the Work and at night horrible tortures.

My God, what can I say of these months of September and October and also of July? Alas, they are three months that no others can compare with in terms of pains and all kinds of tribulations.

In August I had a moment of respite, but the work was so oppressing that this ass was bowed underneath such that it could not bear. Oh, suffering, yes, now you satisfy me well! 33 The desire is ardent, the hunger of suffering || but I feel I will find a way of being satisfied. My God, this is a horrible pain, that of not finding you. The causes are certainly my wickedness, my horrible infamies. Therefore is there any hope of finding you anymore? What pains!

In the dark in which I find myself, alone, are darkness, pains, anguishes, an abyss of tribulations without the minimum comfort, what torment! Oh, at least if I could know how I reached this state; what did I do? 34 I am deprived of the least || comfort.

Communion offered to Saint Catherine of Genoa. Sister Serafina

Today as usual, I received my Communion offering it to St. Catherine of Genoa. What a saint dear to me! There could be no doubt that I would remember to offer it for her today, Thursday. If I forget, as soon as I receive my Good, she reminds me; in this way I ask of her only love and sometimes even providence but for this I have my daughter Sister Anne Serafina. 35 She prays for me and every time I am in need I turn to her with much strength and she does not delay to give me || what I am in need of. Oh, the goodness of a God!

Today, Thursday, 28 October after the Holy Communion, my side! Oh, it stayed the whole day and even now as I write. My Good, it is true that I am really in need of a strong union in order to be able to resist the immense tribulations which continue to come fiercely. Only you can give me strength to be able to sustain so many and cruel sufferings. 36 I do not know how I can resist. If I look at them with simple eyes soon my thought goes to your incomprehensible || strength. I do not know how to thank you, my Good, because I see the whole abyss. I feel it and I bear it. I believe that with your strength everything becomes easy to carry. Oh, for pity’s sake, my Love, give me help and do not leave me.

37 Midnight is nearing; I feel tired of the day, my hand pains me, and my poor head feels weary because of the continuous speaking and thinking. It is too much, but at the thought that everything pleases my God, every || pain of mine becomes sweet and I am eager to do more.

The hand with which I write pains and even the other one, and my bones… Oh, Love!

New sign that announces the death of a Daughter of St. Anne

Tomorrow is Friday and I already feel its closeness. Oh, my Good, my side! Alas, my ribs are breaking! Oh, do not kill me! Your closeness is too much Love, I cannot bear it!

Jesus, my Eternal Father, have pity on me for I feel unable

|| to stand! 38 Two evenings after this fact, at midnight, while

I was sleeping, a shaking woke me up. As I opened my eyes, there was the usual beast half a meter above my head, but instead of having its legs spread it had them curled under the body. On its head it had a black globe and this was detached from the body. It stayed motionless for so long that I said;

Tell me, what is the meaning, who are you? Now I know who you are; I would like to know the meaning. ||

39 As soon as I said this, it disappeared, but it left me trembling. How much I suffered because a superior died!

She was very good, that was why I always kept her as a superior until the end. In that period I did not want to give it to another because though she was sick, it did not prevent her from being a superior. 40 My God, in this way for all the Daughters of St. Anne who depart from this life, now I have a sign: instead of seeing stars as when they announced to me their death, I see beautiful lights || that fly to heaven and of these I saw two covered with a black veil. To the first I said:

My God, who is this soul?

It was as if I felt sadness come down upon me. For the second I asked again:

Who is this?

I understood it was the soul of the superior who certainly was in purgatory. That black veil meant that she suffered much. What pain it aroused in me at the thought that it would have been better to remove her so she could have thought of herself. 41 Oh, if the passage is || so horrible for a superior, my God, what fear I have for myself, what a pain! I do not think that I have to remain always in such an office; it is enough, I am not and I will never be a superior for the mercy of God!

In these days my side raised much at night; sweet union, you are killing me! I cannot avoid lamenting for the ribs, what I felt! 42 I would like to know how to describe what it made me feel, but I am not capable. ||

An Apparition of a holy religious by whom she was counseled earlier

We are in the Novena of the Child of 1880. What does my side do? My ribs are breaking from the moment my side rose. Oh, Love you are killing me!

Today I was in the church and now and then my ribs rose. The union I felt was such that this side… Alas, what I felt!

Before it ceased, I felt like dying. 43 The day before the eve of Christmas, while I was lying down to rest, something kept me awake and I prayed. I saw || a shadow on the wall, as if there was a person from the other side of the bed. I turned in surprise! There was a religious with a surplice; he looked at me and then disappeared. I did not know him because I do not remember the portrait but after thinking well I remembered that he was the holy religious to whom I had written. He had even written to me and replying to him I was telling him a pain I had and asked him to tell me something after having consulted the Lord. I would have prayed for him for what he recommended to me. Oh, beautiful and holy soul! 44 He left me serene || and I had union with my God. In addition my side rose and the heart… what I felt! My ribs!

I stayed in this state for many days and I feel it even now. My ribs! I will not say how much I struggled.

On Christmas night after Holy Communion, I struggled so much that my head suffered. I remained unconscious for the length of a Mass. 45 After recovering it was worse, because || I feared that they may realise. Oh, how much pain I felt!

MS 5. 1 – pp. 45-78

The year 1881 is one of the years where we find scanty notes on the interior life of Mother Rosa: a bit more than thirty pages in her exercise book. The main reason was the lack of time and quiet in the midst of preoccupations and trips. She wrote some notes in the month of January, giving vent most of all in describing the affliction felt in the conversation with a priest, having to justify herself for the slanderous accusations regarding her way as Foundress. This happened on 28 January. At the beginning of February she had to interrupt her writings until 10 May, a day on which taking advantage of an interval made a synthesis of the graces and lights she received in those three months. She proceeds with the month of June, but then again she leaves her notebook at rest. One day she wrote: “The immense work do not allow me to write anymore and this is why I am confused. I do not want to confuse my mind, dear Jesus. In order to put everything clear, I will say that in these months I had such things from my Good that I could not even describe what he suggested.”

The content is not different from that of the other years. The presages of sad events, the death of the Sisters, and the apparitions of dead people … are repeated.

But in order to understand the intensity of the contents of these few pages, it will be good to keep in mind the interweaving of sorrowful events which the Foundress just mentions without naming the concerned persons.

In the months of January and February and the first half of March, Mother Rosa stopped in Rome to negotiate the revision of the Rule of the Institute with the Congregation of Bishops and Regular. She must also reply to the slanderous accusations of some priests which reached the Pope. In the month of June she had another journey to Rome.

On 23 August the first General Chapter of the Institute was celebrated in Piacenza, under the presidency of the diocesan Bishop Monsignor Scalabrini. He had received special instructions from the Roman Congregation which had sent a series of amendments to be inserted in the Constitutions. However, the capitulars interpreted them as simple proposals and rejected most of them. For the Foundress this created a difficult situation in her relationship with Monsignor Scalabrini as well as with the Congregation.

Mother Rosa was called in Rome in forma perentoria. On 3 December she was received by the Prefect Cardinal after waiting for four hours. 45 Finally her integrity in this event will be recognised and every thing will be in order with the help of Cardinal Alimonda, Protector of the Institute and of Monsignor Laurenzi auditor of His Holiness.

Presages of sad events. Pain on the right hand

On the evening of 15 January 1881, I had so much pain that I felt I was dying! While I was in pain I heard two strong beatings that seemed they wanted to shatter the wall and this left me in unbelievable fear. My God, what will happen?

46 Early in the morning there was very sad news that made me feel much sorrow.

I saw a mass of big and small stars. I asked my God if there was one for me and he showed me that at the bottom of these there was one very big star that was hardly visible; those stars were to pass first || and then mine would come. Oh, Love what you made me feel these days!

My side and my ribs, how they rise at night! How my hand pains, I cannot avoid lamenting!

They think that the swelling is caused by much writing but it is what I experience interiorly. It is true that writing does affect it. My arm swells and pains but I must say that this happens for what is in it.

Oh, nights of much suffering! The spasms that I feel are without compare especially the hand || and the side. 47 Even the other hand is not well but it is not like this; I do not feel pain.

Oh, sweet pain!

False accusations of some Bishops to the Roman Curia

Friday 28 January: I had a terrible night. Many times I entrusted my soul for it seemed I was going to die. In the morning, I woke up on time for the Holy Communion and

I prayed to my Jesus so that he might tell me what will happen to me. I did not understand anything and in this way worn out, I said I wanted to go to climb the Holy

Stairs. 48 I wanted to go without bothering with anything. || I climbed the Stairs and I cannot express what consolation I had. I felt that the side, the union with God, was so strong that I feared I had to abandon the place.

Oh, what did I do? I climbed it quickly and went to the chapel to sit down. Meanwhile I was asking my Beloved if I had to go to that superior who had sent word that he was in the house. I was feeling very weak and worn out that I feared I would feel bad before the Bishop:

My God, tell me, what should I do?

49 A lively voice said to me:

Go, I accompany you, || and I will always be with you.

I did not hesitate and soon I went. Oh, certainly if I did not have my Jesus, I would not have been able to resist the many accusations and all lies that I had to hear. Oh, pains!

To see that the person who accused me was one who had been benefited by me and by the Institute and had received immense good! In the same way two Bishops to whom I have done good, the same case. What one Bishop wanted to say I had already known because it was said to other people and also to the sisters.

50 These understood certain mortifications… || They went to the same people to see if they could do the devil’s part.

But they were so attached to the Institute that they could not say more of what they uttered and wrote.

After a long conversation I went back home full of strength and vigour. I thanked dear Jesus for the company and I started working. At night I had other suggestions regarding a sister that… In the same way regarding the answers I had to give for certain accusations that a Bishop had made which were false; || 51 everything because… Oh, world, how traitorous you are! Therefore there was hope… and then what is done…

But I am not worried because there was no truth in it.

Jesus comforted me as usual and in these days he continued to sustain me with his caresses. Oh, how sweet and comforting he is when he comes closer and has compassion for me exhorting me to be patient. Oh, how sweet it is to suffer with Jesus!

A thousand hells together with you my sweet God! The most atrocious pains became so sweet that one feels as if suffering nothing. Oh, what a beautiful day it was for me || Friday! 52 My humanity twisted to hear certain heathen things, but the soul delighted and was so inebriated that I cannot express the joy. My Beloved, Life of my life.

Guided and assisted by Jesus in the answers to the accusations

Today, Monday 31st January: I returned to climb the Holy Stairs, to thank him for the help that Jesus gave me. Weeping I asked him to tell me how I should deal with an affair in which I feared there was illusion and not pleasing to him. In this way addressing the Eternal Father, I offered him the Blood of his Beloved || Jesus. 53 When I reached the top of the stairs a loud voice said to me:

This is my will: let it be done.

Oh, Love! Then the side started rising also and the ribs for the union that I felt. Alas! Soon I tried to quickly climb the stairs; meanwhile I sought my Good, to give me proof that it was his will and that it was really he who spoke to me granting me a grace. I do not doubt having received it because I already see the beginning. Oh, dear Jesus! My Eternal Father, when you want something, you are powerful, and no one can resist you. ||

54 Oh, in these days, how much he caressed me especially after I had suffered much before that superior who slandered me. In addition he had said these things to the Pope, because they were carried to him. It was said of everything; just for the pure mercy of God, they did not touch honesty.

On 28 January what torments! 55 My God, I thought I could not bear them. It seemed to me impossible that human beings put so many lies together. ||

Lights and mysterious signs. Friar Pacifico

The day of Our Lady of Purification I spent in continuous union with God, though I was in the midst of much work. Late in the evening I went to bed praying and looking to the Blessed Virgin Mary with her Child who was at the foot of the bed in the big picture and I turned my eyes somewhere else. 56 I saw a light and from there beautiful flowers could be seen. The first ones were almost white, small wild flowers; the others which came after were beautiful, a kind which || I never saw on earth, as heavy as rain. When these were finished, I saw other small silver ones; later still others small green, red, blue and white bunches.

A group of these last ended on Mary’s bosom, it is in the picture I mentioned above. My God! As these disappeared, I remained sad… I fervently asked for the meaning but I received no reply. Oh, my Love! 57 The pains of these days show me what they signify. ||

One of these days I saw Friar Pacifico128 who appeared to me on high at the back of the bed as if accompanied and he were taken into the air. But I did not see his company. He left me calm because I was upset for an affair; after he passed I was serene.

After several days a big light went around and then went to heaven. 58 In these days I had other consolations regarding sinners but how can I write, my God, since I am absorbed in a thousand || affairs, worn out by toil!

Notice of the death of her grand-daughter

For three months I could not write a line on this exercise book. Today, 10 May 1881, I have a minute of time or rather

I have retired for a minute in the room. I would like to have everything that happened to me in this past period in a flash before my eyes or rather in my mind. Many and countless were the afflictions because of many tribulations. And I also received many graces from my Jesus and I feel unworthy. || 59 Oh, goodness of my God! In February, often while I was in the church a small cypress appeared to me.

What does it mean? – Many times I tried to ask my God.

Then a skull of a small dead person appeared to me and I did not understand what it meant. Even the year 1882 left little time for Mother Rosa to write her reflections, mostly because of the serious affairs regarding the structure of the government demanded by the growth of the Institute and the orientation of the Holy See. On 13 May 1882 the first meeting of the General Council was held, imposed by the Holy See; it was presided over by Cardinal Alimonda and Monsignor Laurenzi. The dispositions of the Chapter of 1881 opposed to the “animadversions” of the Congregation were nullified. The erection of three provinces, two in Italy and one in America, was decreed. The suitability of transporting the General House to Rome was discussed.

The Foundress retook visiting the houses. On 17 December she received the news of the death of her mother whom the earlier day she left dying being needed urgently.

On 23 December, she undertook a long journey to Naples and Sicily. During her brief stay in Naples on 29 December, she had a confession with a “wise and holy Franciscan”, who assured her regarding certain fears she had and encouraged her on the plan of founding the male branch of the Sons of St. Anne. Such foundation was to be followed by the Third Order, that of the Contemplatives according to the vision of the “three drops of blood” which appeared to her one night.

The first months of the year 1883 were dedicated to the long visit of the houses of Sicily. As she returned to Rome she was faced with the enormous cost of the work of the General House; as usual she trusted in the provident love of God. However the usual sufferings return: night suggestions, confusion, solitude… and again eight days of suffering with a painful sickness.
