That was exactly what happened. Oh, what a pain, to suffer for eight days and more! 125 But I prayed much to my Good so that again he might bring remedy in everything without my having to do anything. Oh, what || a gift he gave me!

On the evening before the day in which I was to be healed, I felt a close union that I could not avoid crying. It happened that I was not in my room but in the next room where there was another sister. Thanks to Jesus, this sister realised nothing.

My side! What was going on, only you could say it. 126 Oh, dear Love, what strength you gave me in that union! It was || so great that I did not feel the consequences of the sickness. My Jesus, Eternal Father, my side continues like this. It feels snatches, outbursts so strong that I cannot avoid running away or crying and turning away.

“I have no more hope of forgiveness:

I have lost my Beloved!”

Oh, I try everything but my Good, the Being of my life, promised me that nobody would realise. 127 The tribulations, the sufferings are terrible; I am alone in the dark, || the darkest, cruel torments and the persecution that I receive from the ugly dragon. In addition I have no guide at all of whom I could ask for advice or help. Everywhere I turn I find it locked. I do not know what to say. Alas, what pains, what torments my God! Have you also run away from me?

An abyss of thoughts passed through my mind as a crowd of people with a task to weigh upon me. This state ended and there was another abyss of torments. Where am I? 128 In an abyss; || it seems that for me there is no hope of not having offended my Good. I do not know how to find the motive and yet I am infamous. I have no more hope of forgiveness. I have lost my Beloved! My mind is confused in searching what I could have done; I felt troubled in my soul and wept.

But what is the use of tears, if for me there is no more hope? || 129 It is already some time since I found myself this way and the struggle to hide is terrible and at the end I agonise. Though I find myself in the midst of a multitude of affairs in which I am sunk it is of no use. I cannot see my Beloved. Alas!

I saw the Holy Mother so pale and sad; what will happen? The same is with Mary; white, pale, she gave me signs of much suffering. 130 Well, when I see her like that || in those two pictures, within me I feel deep sorrow; a gloom comes upon me so strongly that I shake myself so that nobody may realise. Oh, if my dear Sisters could see what I suffer! They would certainly suffer much! But I will never allow them to see this. Oh, dear daughters, I am unworthy of calling you so because, I am a poor wretch || who has lost her God. 131 I am infamous but my Beloved, what did I do? The persecutions, the sufferings which I went through for seventeen years in your Work are nothing in comparison to the pain of having lost you! 132 Alas! Now I feel thrown from one to the other side by certain sights that confuse me so much that I do not know how to express myself. They leave || a certain fear which could be the enemy who deludes me. I am without a guide. Jesus, who was my guide, my life, Being of my life, have you abandoned me? Why did my infamy reduce me to this state?

Weeping, I wet the dear crucifix with my tears. 133 I remained more than two hours in this state and then while leaning on the Crucifix I woke up || and it seemed to me that certain thing happened to me.

In my intellect I saw the Blessed Trinity comforting me.

In this way I remained soaked in a sweet balm and fully absorbed in my Good. I can say that I spent a night.

The next day I was very exhausted, but full of that spirit which assured me of being always close to my Good.

“Alone, alone! There is not even my Good who has always been my director, teacher, Father and spouse!” What I felt || in those terrible days of September of 1883!

134 Oh, sufferings of all kinds and tribulations! They were very interior and there were certain nights in which giving vent to the suffering and abandoning myself to it, I was taken by a crowd of thoughts together with the temptation of despair of being abandoned by my Good. 135 I seemed to be deprived of everything; I started meditating and I found an abyss of thoughts that assailed me. An abyss || was opened before me: I thought that for me there was no more mercy because my sins have covered all my actions; I was not able to formulate a good thought, a strong melancholy overcame me and exhaustion came upon me that agonised me. 136 Oh, I have lost everything. I was in the midst of a strong exhaustion and I had no resources to alleviate the least pain. || Alone, alone, there is not even my Good who has always forgotten my sins and has helped me and has always been my director, teacher, father and spouse. Oh, sweet Love, even you have abandoned me? What did I do? Oh, my God, have pity on me, my Beloved, only Being of my life, life of my life. I do not live, you only live for me, but now you have abandoned me!

|| 137 What is life if I do not use it to give pleasure and glory to my Good? What are the tortures if you do not accept them?

At the end what is the use of much toil if you, my Good, do not appreciate them? What is the use of discipline, the penances if you do not love me anymore?

138 Oh, life, why do you not fail me in your torment so that as a sacrifice I can offer you || to my Good; a holocaust and victim of your infamy?

Jesus, pity, have pity on me! Help me; tell me that you still love me so that I can have you again! But could it be presumption? Yes, I am infamous but do not abandon me.

Oh, what an atrocious pain, I have lost my good! 139 I can say for many years I have been without someone to direct me and for more than three months Jesus kept me in the dark; || for me there is no more hope. How the infernal enemy tried to frighten me! How it tormented me moving around the room in a thousand forms. How it came close to frighten me as a fire of dark red light. Ugly monster! It did not allow me to sleep! What a pain! It wakes me continually.

140 I do not understand its coming at every moment, always in different forms and leaves in me || a different type of pain; now a strong unrest, another time fright or again a dark torturing melancholy. Oh, what terrible pains, ugly beast!

Oh, my Love, where are you? Speak to me, tell me that I am yours and you are mine!

Effective intercession of Sister Anne Serafina

I had an interesting affaire of providence and it was coming to a conclusion. What did I do? 141 I turned || to my dear daughter Sister Anne Serafina and received Communion for three days; I promised that if within those three days she helped me to finalise the mentioned affaire I would have asked the novices to offer a triduum of Communion.

On the second day I felt that I would have it and on the third day they were negotiating; in the evening I would have the telegram which would announce to me that everything was concluded.

In the evening I saw nothing; then I thought of being mistaken. 142 However the telegram arrived but the doorkeeper || failed to bring it to me.

Notice of death of an American Sister

Oh, how many things the monster does to me! While I was tired and could not stand on my feet, I hardly lay down that at the top of the bolster it shouted as a wild beast, first in one way and then in another way; it brought me much pain.

Some nights ago I had the sight of a sister but I did not know her; she was a Daughter of St. Anne but from the face she was an American. She stayed looking at me and then vanished.

143 Together, || or at least a bit far from her, two small clear things rose and went to heaven as if to announce to me that the soul of that Sister had gone to heaven. In fact after some days, I heard of the death of a sister; but not of the sister I saw. This one was not an American.

Who could she be? – I went on saying within myself.

A gravely sick person healed through the intercession of Mary

144 In these days I had horrible tribulations because not being satisfied || with bringing me various kinds of difficulties, now they also confuse my conscience. In this way, alone, deprived of every spiritual comfort, there were moments in which I did not know where I was. Moreover to see the person who should help me or at least not torment me acting against the well being of the Work! 145 Oh, only you my Good can explain || my state. Oh, how cruel it is! I am in the midst of a crowd of affairs of every kind and still… Oh, sweet pain that comes to satisfy my great desire of suffering! Oh, sweet Love, consume me on the cross to be close to you for eternity.

Oh, Mary! She came another time to console me while one of my grand-children was seriously sick. 146 One night while I nursed her and I was || kneeling and praying for her healing, the Mater gratiae et misericordiae appeared to me and assured me of the healing. I remained certain but because of the enemy when I saw her relapse I doubted but not completely. I remained doubtful. Alas! She might be the Madonnina who drove away the enemy! I had hardly started to combat it than it appeared to me. || 147 And I heard a voice that said:

Be calm, I will take care.

Oh, what I felt! She gave me strength and held me tight as I said to myself:

Oh, what do you give me! Yes, your grace gives life, makes strong the same skeletons; healed?

In the morning I looked to her image and she was so coloured that I was pleased but later she became pale, not for the grand-child: she showed me another person who was to get sick. || 148 The sadness upset me much.

Unrest, aridity and tribulations

On the eve of the Immaculate, what a night! After having done a good amount of discipline until bleeding, in thanks giving and for other graces that I was in need, I was very exhausted though the blood was not much because I do not have much; however, it was enough to weaken me to a point that I was not able to sleep. 149 When it seemed || that I was sleeping, I was taken by something and it seemed that I was dying. I do not speak of the noise that ugly monster did because now it whistled in one ear and then in the other. Oh, what unrest it brought to me! In this way, after two hours of much suffering and it really seemed I was dying, I decided to go down and call my secretary || who always helped me with much charity. 150 May God bless her for her charity!

I also had my side… I tried to turn away as much as I could because my poor bones were rising. For some days I had to try to move around because if I remained stationary and did not distract myself there were troubles. Oh, my Love!

151 But I also had aridity || and still worse because there were days of such tribulations that carried me to despair; to see that I was in an abyss deprived of everything, without having anyone to turn to, just the least torturing thought.

Sensation of having mistaken everything

152 It seemed to me that everything I did was done badly;

moreover everything had disappeared and nothing was offered and remained at the feet of my God. I was only emptiness || and nothing more. Worse, everything was done carelessly and had gone with the wind. Oh, what a pain, what a torment is this! In addition, my Beloved was displeased with what I did and I was doing. Therefore I am the most abject creature. What a pain to be on earth!

153 Oh, yes, my Good, || I confess before you and before the people that I have never done anything. But what other thought have I had other than pleasing you! Oh, no! Eternal

Father, have pity on me! By obedience it was imposed on me by your Vicar, who cannot err. 154 Oh, nothing, nothing could help me to regain certainty and at least to take away from || my mind the terrible spectacle in which I was; that I always feel a strong thrill. What a terrible state! And more so to be alone! It is almost a year that I have not said a word; I do not have anyone to turn to. And have not had for eleven months now…

155 I could say that it has been always the same, because when one has not certainty to say || one must often wait for months… Oh, terrible state! I wish that no human creature had to experience it. It is a very cruel kind of suffering because I am always throttled by the concern as to whether my Good is happy. Could this and that other be pleasing to him? Alas, what pains are these?

On the other hand, she always felt to be guided by Jesus in his Work

Many times Jesus suggested to me saying yes. Then I work and seem to do everything well. 156 I do not feel || any pain, I know he is the one ordering me and I his poor ass try my best to keep the burden on my back and I work wholeheartedly.

Oh, my dear Love – I said every now and then – are you happy now?

And when there are difficulties:

My Beloved, tell me, what should I do? How should I act? How should I reply? ||

157 Many other times I said:

Speak for me, my Good.

Oh, what a joy then! I speak without thinking what I say and what I should reply; I could say the word was placed in my mouth and many times I am pleased to hear what beautiful things he said. Certainly I, a miserable ass, would not be able to say half a word. || 158 In the same way when he shows me certain tribulations which take place in his Work he never or rarely reveals to me the person who caused things. No, he tells me everything half way. For the death of the Sisters and of other people he shows me a skeleton but he does not tell me who the person is. 159 All the ranks of people are distinguished || but he does not tell me who is who.

Sometimes I felt terrible sufferings because I feared that it might be one or the other and I became fearful. For the sisters, I already said, they are all stars: someone big, someone smaller, for the superiors always more beautiful. I say always:

Oh, if the superiors could see what a beautiful grace the Holy Mother grants || them! 160 They are not only privileged like the others with a star, certainty of salvation of their souls but also for those who became superiors recently and many times they are not yet fully… And yet their star is always bigger than that of the other sisters. 161 Certainly, among these, there are those – I am saying of the superiors - || very big and bright and depending on the work they have done in his Work and if they have been zealous in observance.

Oh, I saw those that were very big and beautiful and at the moment of death a strip appeared to me as when the lightning comes through the window. 162 The brightness comes close and rises to || heaven. Oh, of these very beautiful big ones I saw two: one before it rose it went all around me as if for a feast and in act of greeting and thanking me: now it rose, it came closer to the earth and at the end after various rounds in that same way, it went away. Oh, beautiful and blessed soul! 163 In fact she also appeared to another sister and told her many good things. Oh, || dear daughter, pray for me.

“Terrible sufferings without comfort;

real sufferings of purgatory”

Today an interior fear continued within me as if something bad was to happen. The more I drove it away the more I felt it. I have that bad feeling, a kind of fainting. It cannot be explained; only the person who experienced it can understand it.

I saw a thousand jokes done to me. 164 That ugly monster, how it studies them all! Now I can understand || and say that it was a temptation. But there are moments and days in which it is not given to me to understand.

Though crowded by a thousand thoughts for the Work of the Lord, there is nothing that can distract me; moreover many times an argument arises in order to make me realise that I am there. 165 Alas, what a horrible state! As I write I feel something of repugnance in coming back to this || terrible point, which takes away everything. Prayer becomes a burden; I turn to my Good in order to find my usual union and comfort. Oh, I am all in a muddle and a perturbation comes upon me. My God, come to my help! It is so strong that it affects even my body and I feel like fainting. Oh, if in that moment I could have a word of comfort! I feel an extreme need. || 166 No, only my Good, but I do not meet him.

He went far away from me: what could be the reason?

What did I do? My God, have pity on me! Oh, terrible pains, without comfort; they are real pains of purgatory.

Turning on all sides I cannot find relief, not a minute of respite. 167 Only when it pleases my Good taking me out of it; then everything vanishes. I do not || remember that I suffered and in him I am serene in the midst of many sufferings of all kinds. They do nothing to me, because with my Good near me suffering is sweet. But when he leaves me, alas! Terrible sufferings do not come; no, no! More sufferings but with you, never in the dark where there can be only fear of having displeased you.

Apparition of the “Madonnina” of Father Bernardo

On 19 1 December 1883, the eve of the death of Father

Bernardo, towards midnight while I was in my room the “Madonnina” that he kept in hand in a small picture appeared to me in a cloud, beautiful and radiant. She stayed in the room almost the whole night. I was not able to say anything, but I remained enraptured gazing at her. She had a magnificent frame and I promised to prepare for her the same in the morning.

2 On that day, that is 20 December, while I was lying down at midnight I felt a strong perfume || mixed with incense; it spread on the blanket that I was covered with since it was very cold. Oh, how much sweetness and something of joy I felt which stayed for the whole of the following day.

I saw many stars and I still continue to; I saw a skeleton and other skulls.

Strong temptation against suffering

The night of Christmas, what I felt! When all went to bed I returned to the church. 3 Oh, my side! The union I felt was indescribable; my bones rose. Jesus my Love! ||

For the whole of the following day I continued to have such a union; I understood a thousand things, all regarding the Work. The suffering that I had to undergo still was terrible and there were moments in which I was fainting.

But soon I put effort and asked for forgiveness of my God. The sicknesses and everything I went through were not of little importance. My God!

While I was suffering I was assailed by a strong temptation and the suffering prevented me from breathing. I had fidgets if with the help of God I did not struggle to be still… || this was painful. 4 A loud voice said to me:

Curse the sickness you have!

Oh, what a pain! What a battle! The sickness afflicted me and the battle was such that I was not able to release myself. No, I love you, sweet suffering! But the temptation seemed to overcome me, because it was stronger; it was as if I agreed; it seemed that from my mouth came out:

No, no!

Every now and then for a minute it seemed me a relief to cry:

No, no my Jesus, || I love suffering! 5 Go away ugly serpent! Mary, come to my help, I cannot bear it anymore!

One must experience it in order to understand how strong this temptation was. But, my dear mother, the sweet mother did not delay in coming to my help and she healed me. She let me know clearly certain things that took place in the Work, illustrations…

I also saw many small stars which indicated the death of some sisters and a big one. This one escaped me. 6 Immediately I was not able to understand if it was || for a superior or a soul that went to heaven, because it did not give me time to see it well. Since it did not return, I think that a superior will not die. It might belong to a soul who went to heaven.

Skeletons, and skulls; how much of these strolled in my room! They were very frequent!

For a long time, I did not see beasts; one evening there came one with a big white tail. The remaining was all black || and it was frightening. 7 It left me convulsion as if something sad was going to happen:

My Eternal Father, for you everything is little. My enormous sins, my infamies merit worse!

MS 5.3 – pp. 1-46

The year 1884 occupies almost the whole of file 5.2 of the manuscript and the beginning of file 5.3. After the month of March, there is a long interruption. Then she started: “From the month of April I cannot write a line because of my involvement in many other activities. My Good goes on telling me to write and when if not at night? During the day it is difficult. My Good, what can I do?” Earlier she remembers the experiences she had before; first of all the sickness and death of Sister Anne Francesca, after the struggle she sustained with Pius IX, whose intercession she often invoked.

They were the months of desolation and temptations even against the Church, which were the most painful for the Servant of God. There were moments in which she saw hell open under her feet. From March of the same year, she had Father Bernardino da Portogruaro, minister general of the Franciscan Minor as a confessor and spiritual guide who regulated her penances and the night vigils. In reality she found herself lonelier than before, because by this time she did not feel guided by the supreme Good; she even felt forgotten and far away from him.

The plan of the Third Order of St. Anne delayed for many years became something different through the intervention of the Bishop. There were also uncertainties regarding the plan for the foundation of the Sons of St. Anne. The devil persecuted her with temptations of discouragement. She wrote: “Gloom is at my side. I have always a terrible darkness: I feel a strong grip at my breast… I suffer horribly and without any relief…”

She thought of the great saints who had a guide that gave them light and comfort. As for herself, she felt more alone than ever. But the Lord insisted on telling her that it was his will that she stay under the direction of the Franciscan Father General. All this provoked a strong resistance in the spirit of Mother Rosa: she preferred to continue under the direct guidance of her Good. She spent the year in the midst of inexpressible interior anguishes and glimmers of light and of peace of paradise, while she was worried for the 7 epidemic of cholera which was spreading in the big cities of the Mediterranean coasts. She offered herself as a victim.

Diabolic illusion of a sister

On 24 January 1884, I went to consult a servant of God about certain things that were said of a Daughter of St. Anne to whom a friar was appearing…

8 Since I was convinced that it was the devil and that it could not be anything else || for she did not have any lofty virtue. He told me that it was the devil who took that form and moreover the same devil deluded the good friar who believed that everything was from Jesus. Instead … How easy it is to be deluded! He left me so calm on this point that I cannot describe it fully; in this way I continued staying with Jesus.

Sweetest union with Jesus

|| 9 On the eve of Our Lady of Purification I went to the church at one o’clock in the morning and while I was kneeling on the platform of the altar I prayed to my Beloved that he may embrace me more strongly in the contemplation.

When I was taken by him, my soul was infinitely delighted and in this state I remained for two hours. When I recovered, I was in my Beloved. My sight felt to be in much union and my ribs… Oh, my God, how can I express myself? ||

10 I received many lessons and knowledge on things I must do regarding the Work. Oh, sweet Master, how wise and sweet your lessons are! Love!

I remained near my Good until four o’clock in the morning, I can say in a very sweet union.

Oh, Love, enclosed in the tabernacle, speak to me! Oh, no, you make me die! I felt that I could not continue.

I had doubts and he took them away; I had fears and he assured me. 11 Oh, my sweet Beloved! ||

The gift of discernment on the interior disposition of the sisters On the third of the same month, at two o’clock at night,

I was kneeling on the platform in the same position but the delight was different. I felt a certain sadness and then I felt a wound in the chest.

12 I stayed as if wrapped in darkness and again a big beast which I saw before going to my room came to my mind. Its appearance was strange big and all interwoven || with other small ones. In addition there was a very beautiful big and bright star that dazzled me.

Oh, who will die among the superiors? Because it was very big and beautiful as usual.

When a superior dies, they are always more or less very big. Later I saw some small ones; 13 I was not mistaken because at the same hour, a very clever superior was breathing her last in a hospital. || Oh, blessed are they whom the Holy Mother signs with predilection. Oh, if they new it!

They would certainly desire to be so and to be good; they would endeavour to do good for her Institute. But when they start doing bad, without willingness and understanding, I feel something towards them that keeps me away from them and makes me feel bad to be with them.

14 Everything they say and do || seems not to be true and this gives me pain that I cannot describe.

I try to overcome my feelings and to persuade myself because many times I had not yet realised anything and I say:

Jesus, my beloved, this must be the devil who tries to disturb me, but it cannot be true because she is a good crea- ture. I pray much so that the anxiety may be taken away from me but || it does not happen at all.

15 I try to be closer to her with more caresses but it is worse. I suffer an indescribable pain within me and I hear a voice telling me: she deceives you! What a pain!

Petitions made climbing the Holy Stairs

Today 15 February, while I climbed the Holy Stairs, at the first Stair I asked my Jesus for five graces. For the first he said that I would have it soon; for the second he said it will take time; for the third I will be granted. The fourth which was regarding providence, I asked him from which side would I receive the fifty lire. || 16 In a paper I had he told me from whom I would receive it. I never thought of it.

I will have them unexpectedly and I will have everything I asked for. He also told me that I will have the fifth grace.

I prayed for two people who did much evil to me and I am still suffering. I prayed for a Daughter of St. Anne who had to remove the veil. I had nothing but he made me feel he was pleased that I prayed for this and for the other. 17 He assured me of nothing but I felt || very comforted as I entrusted to him these people. I promised to suffer resigned and try not to speak. Oh, how much he comforted me while I said to him: my Beloved, Love, I am alone! And I groaned because all the creatures have a support but me I am alone and if he… Oh, what answers, what assurance! He will always be with me and … Oh, Love! What I felt!

He has always been my teacher and he will hide himself no more. || I went on crying. 18 Oh, my Love, sweetest Beloved!

Today within me I had a certain cheerfulness which gave me enough strength to distract myself from things which made me suffer. In the afternoon, as I started the Holy Stairs, as usual before climbing I asked my Eternal Father and my Beloved that for the blood and the infinite pains … 19 he may grant me the graces I would ask him. Oh, || infinite goodness yes, he granted me everything; only for one grace more time would be needed. I asked him for the (…) and he answered me very clearly:

They will be.

I asked for the conversion of a sinner and he answered:

He will be converted.

But I always desired to know the time; and my Love said:

Soon!

I tried to know something of two people: about one he said badly and about the other one I saw nothing clear.

However, certain thoughts passed in my mind regarding from where providence would come. He showed me that it will come from afar and it will come soon. 20 Oh, Love, when will I have… || This he showed me was still far off.

Outbursts of Love with the rising of the ribs

Oh, most loving Jesus! I do not speak about what my side felt in these moments. Oh, how the poor ribs rose and

I felt it so much that I could not bear it. But when I was able, I tried to turn away; otherwise I could have cried. But in my room in Piacenza, there I remained completely in God. Oh, what I felt! 21 There were moments in which it seemed to me that I was dying || and the side of the heart, the same heart was coming out. Oh, what moments!

Oh, I die! I die! – I went on lamenting. Jesus I die, pity on me, move aside. I cannot bear anymore!

But when I go to the houses, how cruel it is to live, for I must always deprive myself and try to turn away. Only some nights in the church, but I always fear being heard. Jesus, your promise, that no one should realise, have pity, you had promised it to me!

22 At night a surge assailed me || and until I could, I said:

Move aside, have pity, that they may not hear me!

But when I am in him… I suffer much not to cut off the wool and this chokes me and makes me faint; but what can

I do? If I cut it they will realise and then? I prefer to suffer the cold instead of the fire that burns me. If they could feel, what pain! But it is very sweet! || While I write, what I feel! 23 It is midnight and I go to sleep because I cannot stand anymore. Oh, I burn, I am consumed, my Love, my side.

Profound aridity without comfort

The state of my soul now is terrible; on all sides I see a precipice of great failures that is a dread. But when I want to bring together my thoughts I do not find even one. Therefore, My God, whose are those which terrify me always? 24 I am arid; only now and then when I am || much oppressed I have a moment of much union and I feel destroyed. I forget everything and I feel reborn. I do not fear going back to the abyss of that suffering when unexpectedly I find myself there; what pains are these! 25 Without any comfort, alone, alone in the torturing suffering, I seem || to have lost everything; in a word, everything is locked. There is nowhere I can take refuge.

Vision of Our Lady of Oropa

On the evening of 8 March 1884 while I was resting late at night, I was perplexed at the thought that I should have spent the night in the chapel but I had a cough and I did not feel well. 26 While I struggled on this the Blessed Virgin with the Child appeared to me; she was standing on the world and kept the Child at the waist. She laughed and kept || the scepter on the other hand. This happened twice, and they said nothing to me. The Mother as well as dear Jesus had the crown on their heads. I said:

Is it the devil who deludes me? Is it not the dear Mater Gratiae et Misericordiae

Who always assisted me? What will happen?

27 I do not remember having seen a similar image; the Child was a bit grown, cheerful and the same the Virgin with the scepter. || I went on repeating within myself:

What does it mean? What meaning could the scepter have which she clearly presented?

I spent a night of paradise, always making spiritual communions. I prayed and I was very calm, the same during meditation. Moreover I always kept her before my eyes; the Child seemed to want to come to me. Oh, Love! Love, what will happen? What does it mean?

28 I asked if there were Our Ladies || with that Child; I asked in a manner that no one could suspect what happened to me.

They told me that she was Our Lady of Oropa,138 who had a very beautiful sanctuary. I cannot express the desire I felt of going there. Oh, sweet Mary! Mary, your love consumes us, but it is little, it 29 is little, make me die of it! ||

Much pain and consolation

10 March 1884. At Holy Communion, what I saw! The

Host, very beautiful and bright, disappeared immediately for it entered into my heart. It was already ten minutes since

I had received and it appeared to me to indicate how it stayed within me.

Oh, days of great suffering! But my Good assisted me and comforted me; he directed me in the smallest things.

The nothingness I felt cannot be described, nothing as I am, less than nothing. My Good is always with me to suggest things to me; but did I do what || he told me? 30 Alas, it was done so badly!

I find myself lacking in everything. I would like to do well, but I do not do it. I always find pretext to excuse myself and then? And then what happens? I find myself very confused.

This night, the day before the eve of St. Joseph at midnight, while I was kneeling at the platform near my God, what my side felt! ||

31 I could not stand and I went to lie down. Around one o’clock, my side… Oh, it was raised so much that even the skin was torn. Oh, what I felt! In the morning, the eve of St. Joseph, my Love, what I felt, you could say it!

“A Thousand million pains, but not purgatory!”

After receiving Holy Communion, perhaps after ten minutes while I was giving thanks, a big globe of fire appeared to me. I asked who it was and I was told:

I am Sister Anne P. le and I am in purgatory; I am in need of prayers.139

32 Well, immediately I offered the Holy Communion || and I promised to offer it for her if she obtained for me providence for I needed to have it soon within these days for the building. I told her in which heart she must put the impulse to send them. She listened and left me sure that she will do it. 33 In addition for the faults which kept her in purgatory and for which she suffered much I added the fasting || for 15 days.

She left me very assured as if in an act of gratitude she made me feel confident. Oh, the goodness of God! Much mercy towards me, poor and unhappy, full of iniquity, good only to displease him! I do not know what I should do for him. I would do everything, and I conclude nothing. What will happen? 34 Oh, dear souls pray and obtain for me that I may not || be stationed in such a horrible room of purgatory. Oh, no, a thousand million pains but not purgatory! For you, wicked greed, even many beautiful souls go to purgatory and me who is full of these sins? Alas, Jesus have mercy on me!

In search of a spiritual director

35 I had some sad days and among the many pains there had been one very painful and it is this: I was without direction and certainly I did not do well. It would have been better || to search for someone to whom I could say whatever passed within me. I went to confession to a saintly and wise religious and I hinted to him something very small. He answered me saying that I must pray much to Jesus and he would let me know if it was his will that I search for a director for my soul or if he wished to be my director, Jesus the only director. This is what I did, but I was not able to pray at all. 36 I was confused and unsatisfied || with this advice. Although I did not speak much, I had the impression I felt as if I committed some sin.

Interiorly in my poverty, I felt something that seemed outside of my centre or to be grumbler, never happy. 37 I do not know how to express it because the thoughts were an abyss of every kind which invaded my mind. It was and still it is a martyrdom; || in me the turmoil never ceased.140

“My Good goes on telling me to write”

From the month of April I have not been able to write a line for the immense activities that take me away from my duty. Now I cannot remember what my Good worked and did in me. My God, help me! Now, late at night, how can I rest? Since I was told not to stay awake, should I obey my Good? 38 For some days he went on || telling me to write, and when if not tonight? During the day it is difficult; my Good what should I do?

I am so battled that I remain confused. Well, just half an hour and then I will sleep. The things which happened to me were without compare.

I found myself in much anguish and many times my teacher relieved me by instructing me.

I saw the heart of a sister that pretended. At other times I saw a big and some small stars. ||

39 I do not speak of the number of beasts I had in my room. I cannot number them because they were many. They tormented me so much in a thousand ways that I was unable to sleep; they annoyed me by shaking the bed and in many other ways.

Vision of Pius IX in the occasion of sickness and death of Sister Anne Francesca

For the sickness of my dear Sister Anne Francesca what I felt! 40 After having offered many novenas I said: ||

Let us do a triduum to Pius IX.

The first day it was done before his small image. The sick sister kept a photograph in her hands and three times Our Father, Hail Mary and Glory were recited. The second day the same was done; 41 but what a surprise! At the second Our Father, there Pius IX, dressed as a Pope with the red hat on his head and with open arms came from the side of the door but on high in an act of embracing the sick; near by he had || a small cypress. At the sight of such a vision, I was unable to continue and I remained ecstatic. I said:

No, no, stop, do not come to take her, but bless her so that she may be healed! I do not want, no, no!

As for himself, always in the same position he remained stationary and then disappeared. Oh, what a melancholy he left me!

Why do you want her? If you take her away, you understand well that I will be afflicted!

42 As I recovered || again I tried to continue the Our Father- Hail Mary and the Glory, but the sick had realised.

In the evening I said nothing to her, I only stood up and went to the church to complain to Pius IX.

Oh, this is too much! When there is a clever Daughter of St. Anne, you take her, no, no! Come and bless her, yes,

I want it, you must heal her!

43 I always hoped that the next day, || the last day he would have come to heal her.

In vain I said the Our Father- Hail Mary and the Glory, but I saw nothing. The sick begged me to tell her what happened. I told her concealing the fact of the cypress that was near the Pope. She wanted to know what I thought, if that was for death or for healing. 44 Unfortunately it was for death, but how could I say it? I let the thing go without giving a judgment but inside me || the pain was very much. My

God, what a pain! In this way I tried to prepare her in time and after she made a very beautiful death. I saw her soul going to heaven because in that little time in which she stayed in agony she expiated her purgatory; I saw it with my eyes.

Oh, what a beautiful soul!

45 I went to the room where the other sisters were weeping and I said to them:

Sing the Laudate instead || of weeping. As soon as I said this again there came Pius IX in an act of thanking me and to take his leave; he then went to heaven. Oh, dear daughter, blessed are you, that so young, you went to heaven to possess your spouse for eternity! Pray for me. I did not leave out offering Communions but always in honour and glory. I asked her for proofs or rather signs and she gave me.141

Horrible temptations against the Church. “I am lost!”

I will not speak of the afflictions I have had in these months because they were without || compare. 46 My God only your strength could sustain me to resist such painful sufferings! I am in maximum desolation; I had horrible temptations against the Church. My God, I am a monster of infamy! While for the Pope, the Cardinal Princes, the Bishops, what I would not do! My life is nothing to offer for the prosperity of the holy Church. Alas! 47 How grievous I find this state! The clutches that the ugly || monster uses terrify me and I am alone. What a dreadful, life; it is a true torture! There are moments in which I see the horrible hell under my feet and I find nothing that can save me. Mary, Mother of mercy does not listen to me anymore; I am alone. Jesus has abandoned me because the ugly monster of sin made this happen. Oh, what pain!

I go to confession, and what am I told? Just when I say:

I am full of || sins, I cannot tell them apart.

48 Be calm, where are they? – I am replied.

I said within myself: - Might this be another sacrilege?

The torture became horrible. What a pain, my God!

For me there is nothing. I am not even able to pray because I am not listened to by my Good. What should I do? Scourge myself? But how can I if obedience forbids me? If I do that, it will be another 49 fault which I have to unite with the || others; so does this mean that my Good does not like me to show obedience to anyone but to himself? Oh, for pity’s sake, tell me what I should do; I do not know how and where to turn!142

I see that I am lost. After many toils I did nothing but afflict my Good. Pity, my Love, pity! 50 Yes, I merit everything but pour a drop of your mercy! ||

Prevision of epidemic of cholera.

“I am in trouble with my Love!”

Beasts of every kind stroll in my room. In the first half of June I foresaw a very bad epidemic which was to come but very far from here. In fact cholera came into France. After the early days of August again I saw the same epidemic but nearer, and the cholera reached to Italy, mostly near here, and may

God not allow that it would arrive here. 51 Oh, have mercy!143

The suffering is so great because in the unrest || that I feel of being abandoned by my God and not being able to pray, I seem to be outside the mercy of God.

I am a trunk that cannot be listened to because I have nothing good; I feel nothing. Alas, I am really an infamous person because of my faults. My God, pity me! 52 He does not instruct me anymore. ||

I am taken by a horrible melancholy, it almost make me faint. What he wanted to obtain from me could be that I let go of everything without taking to heart anything. What a horrible state is this! I am told:

Look at the horrible toil, and why do you do it? You take care of all these affairs and at the end what do you obtain? 53 Nothing at all and your soul is still worse because you are not in grace; || you do everything for the body and nothing for the soul. You are a scandal and you are not persuaded that you should care only for the affairs of the soul and the like…

Oh, they are horrid pains, horrible torments; one suffers and agonises without comfort. How can I stand alone? I am so oppressed that I do not want to do anything but weep; I always want that the night could be longer so I could stay in my room and weep. 54 Oh, even those condemned to || death have relief. As for me, I am alone, abandoned by all; what horrible pains, my God!

The other night again I saw many signs of a grave epidemic towards the sides of Riviera di Levante of Genoa. What a horrible sight! It was on 18 August 1884 and how frightened it left me! It was horrible and I was not able to sleep. It left me a horrible anxiety at the thought that many people would die. My God, what a torment! ||

55 Last night, 25 August 1884, I had other signs of an epidemic which advanced towards us but was very mild. Oh, that the good God may free us; he may not look at our unworthiness but to his mercy!

In the same way at the end of thanksgiving I saw a skeleton. Oh, how it hid its face! I was unable to see it! It impressed me and I thought:

This must be a priest because when they are religious this is how they come.

My God, who could it be? 56 How || I am taken by melancholy and how I suffer! How hard it is to pretend! What pains, my God!

In my thoughts there is nothing else but that I am in trouble with my Good. Nothing helps me to turn away this sad anxiety: how painful it is not to find my Good anymore! He left me because I am infamous and this is why I cannot meet him anymore.

Oh, what sufferings! What is death compared to these? 57 What are all the pains put together in comparison of the loss I had? || Oh, I feel so oppressed that I cannot stand. Mary, come to my help, for pity’s sake!

I am so oppressed that I do not know where to turn my head and how to pray. I am deprived even of prayer by something which I do not know. Horrible state! My Love, where are you? I cannot bear the pain anymore, pity, my God! 58 If I am the cause of such || grave misfortune how can I remedy it if I cannot do it by my blood. Tell me my God, must I remain like this? Perhaps you do not like it? Oh, on- ly a hint and I will do everything in a flight; but you do not let me feel at all! What can I do?

“I fear it might not be the will of God that I think of the Third Order of St. Anne”

This situation is as hard as death. 59 What can it be that I always see a mitre? Will someone die? ||

Now I see it on the head of a dead person, and now as on a living person. It comes closer as if I must have afflictions; interiorly I feel something and I already expect many afflictions.

The Work of the Tertiary, is it placed with the Bishop?

60 Perhaps it is not this but something else for which I must struggle. Oh, I already fight with the enemy who has waged

|| a war inside me that is horrible! Such an aversion comes in me that I do not know how to overcome it. It always incites me to leave it. It tells me:

No, what do you do? Is the burden you carry not enough that you wish to embrace another one which you would certainly not be able to bear?

61 Oh, what a pain, my God! || The flesh feels oppressed and my poor head does not know where to find peace and calm. I am battled on all sides. This is the reason why the enemy is strong, but oppressed as I am, many times I am taken by anxiety and in that moment I say:

No, I do not want to do anything.

62 I fear that it might be the devil who brings all this || work in order to see me surrendered. I am speaking in an abstract way and saying it seems to relieve me and in this way my fear is being confirmed to be true, that it might not be the will of God that I busy myself with the Third Order.

What confusion takes place in my mind! Who will calm me? Who will assure me with a word of advice that it is the will of God for me to do it? || 63 No one. I am completely alone. Only the enemy with strong suggestions torments me; it shows me that doing this is being an ass. In this other Work I will have to go through much suffering because it is not the will of my God that I do it. What a horrible struggle; it puts me in a muddle!

64 Yes, it is true that I know it is the ugly one but at certain moments it covers itself and it pretends to be holy; || on one side it takes the good of this Work of my God and makes me observe in a subtle way that this and that are not good. I am a poor soul so lonely with an abyss of affairs to be sustained. The worst thought is that I could do the least thing which would not be his will… || 65 Oh, how painful is this, I cannot describe it! Should I give up? Oh, what can I do? Could I be mistaken?

Then inside me is repeated:

Remember the three drops of my blood that I showed you and I poured in to your heart; I told you they will be the three Orders that you will found.144

Oh, my Love, how could it be – I go on saying within myself – I am very old || what can I do? 66 I am full of pains, I am sick and I feel I cannot continue. It is true that you bring the dead to life and to the agonising work, because I could say that my suffering is a daily agony; I do not speak of the pains because it would require too much.

Uncertainty regarding the plan of the Sons of St. Anne

67 On 4 October, there will be the Third Order of St. Anne Adorers and the other is the Sons of St. Anne.145 Oh, these give me much pain! || Often new means are offered to me to start but I do not have the courage. It is something stronger than me and keeps me bound up in too many activities.

It does not mean that I do not want to suffer. No; it just seems me that the strength will not sustain me. 68 But then?

And always with “but then” I stop || even if inside me there is a continuous regret, something which peacefully remains inside and is felt without noise. But when I want to start the work a volcano of turmoil invades me and I remain frightened. 69 I have no more courage to go ahead and I abandon everything; || I remain with the reproach. What can I do?

Who will give me the strength?

I do not hear a word that he suggested me what to do.

It is true that it was my Good, who told me, but many years have passed and I thought that this issue would never come up again. 70 I was persuaded that I was mistaken, that it was something else that my Good wanted from me. Though I wanted || to be persuaded in this way interiorly as I said above I felt much turmoil in my head.

“Melancholy is at my side, I have a terrible darkness”

Yesterday night, as I went to bed after midnight, since I had a severe headache, I was quiet to see if it would improve. Not at all! The beasts started strolling on all sides;

there was one with a strange shape and it disappeared through the wall near || my head. 71 The others I almost did not see but they made noise near the door and caused me much pain. I slept just a bit towards the morning. I had a dream, if it could be called like that, because I was almost waking up. I saw a sick, mad person; who was she? Oh, what an atrocious pain! I jumped from the bed and I felt so upset and went to the church. I saw the Madonnina so sad.

|| Moreover, she seemed to be breathing her last. 72 Oh, what a pain! I do not know how to express it. My God, why do you make me suffer so much and I always find myself under very hard trials?

How much I hear from the enemies and they are always new. They give me so much anxiety about having lost my Good and I find myself in the abyss, the cruelest there could be. || 73 There is nothing that could bring me peace, no; the worst thing is to be alone, my God! I do not know what to think and where to turn; what can I do?

Melancholy is at my side I have a terrible darkness. I feel a strong grip at my breast that makes me think I will die at any moment. If I could describe my state! Oh, certainly, a human mind would not understand it.

74 I continually feel the need to weep. || But when will I find my Good, the Being of my life?

“I suffer horribly and without relief”

For many days I have seen a blue star, a notice for a good lay person, a parent or an acquaintance; and I feel pain. I also saw a very large cypress. I cannot describe the pain that it brought me. All these people and sights which are not explained to me cause me grave thought.

My God, who can it be? – I go on saying || within me.

75 But many times what I think becomes true. I certainly feel upset and often true agony. If the people could read inside me certainly they would feel pity, but I only say I suffer horribly and without relief; only suffering is faithful to me. 76 Oh, what a torture it is || to have lost my Good! I am alone in the midst of cruel torments of every kind. When I am deprived of my Good, I cannot have peace. It was he who lived for me and now how can I continue? Oh, a word, a relief, what a pain!

Oh, blessed souls of purgatory, you can understand my suffering! 77 But you are sure that as || the time passes, you will be near the Beloved, but me? I am a scoundrel of hell, I deserve nothing; what did I do? Where am I? My poor head cannot bear anymore; I feel like fainting!

I spent a horrible night; I was not visited by the beasts but I heard noises and felt strong pain. While it seemed to me that I was asleep, there I felt like dying; I was as someone passing away. My God, what a pain! 78 The bed || was shaking! What can I do my God?

I had no strength to wake up; I felt faint, I was alone. I made an act of contrition and then I was calm in the suffering, very upset for having lost my Good.

A small gulp of sweetness in Holy Communion

This morning I had a small gulp of sweetness in Holy

79 Communion, but since the enemy stays strong at my side, it suggested every kind of filth and told me that I was guilty of || those sins. What a dread! I tried to obtain a word from my Love, in the same way from Mary; but my hope was in vain.

I went to work and I found it toilsome; but what is felt when there is a strong pain in the soul? One works but with difficulty; everything becomes unbearable and there is nothing which could save me. My God alone! It is the maximum pain.

Blessed are the saints who had their spiritual guides

80 I hear being read the || life of a saint. What a consolation and assurance it was for them to be directed by obedience and they rested in peace in their tribulations. St. Magdalene de

Pazzi suffered very much but her guide comforted her much.

What St. Teresa felt, but how she was comforted by the treasure of obedience! I poor sinner, in the midst of many affairs… and my poor soul, || what will become of me?

81 When I hear about these lives of saints being read, I go on saying within myself: As for them they were great people and they had their guides; as for me, I am a poor ignorant rag and I am alone in this cruel state. I feel like weeping, I cannot bear listening and I must retire.

I suffer without any comfort. 82 Only in the past my Good, || when he saw me in much suffering, in his goodness, he comforted me and guided me but not now. How is it? What did I do?

Before he told me that he was my only director and it should be like that, but now it is not like that. My God, these are pains of hell! I understand that he wants me to be guided by another, in this way leaving me to expiate my disgracefulness. 83 They are painful sufferings and certainly not understood and my || ignorance does not allow me to explain.

Finally today after Holy Communion I started to feel a bit of peace and this evening I feel my side giving me certain shocks and in some moments strong snatches! Oh, my Love, though you do not speak to me I feel you and therefore you still love me. I am yours! Oh, what a thought!

God wants me to place myself under the direction of the Franciscan General

Friday 28 August. 84 Oh, my Love what a night I spent! My ribs, my side! The union || was so strong that I was feeling faint or rather I remained absorbed. Oh, yes, that my Good filled me with a certain comfort and assured me that it was his will that I place myself under the direction of the F.G.146

Yes, my Good, what I would not do to execute this exactly and to please you! I will tell him everything without keeping back anything even if it will cost me a thousand agonies, yes, everything.

85 On Sunday || 31 August, while the Venerable was exposed, my Good showed me himself, beautiful, but his face was much bigger than the Host. Oh, he was white, very shining. His light was spreading all around.

Sad presages, worries and fears

Oh, my Love, many signals of sisters who will die! Small stars always come to upset me. In the same way I feel with- in me that a grave event will take place. God, what can it be? || 86 I hear certain strong blows now here and now there even inside the church. My God, what a pain!

The Madonnina shows herself now with black hands and then with a pale face. In fact I am never mistaken because she indicated to me that a child was sick; and that was what happened. Now I see greater signs! My God, what pains these are!

87 The same for providence: he assured me that it will come, but I would like it to come quickly || and I feel it.

This evening I continued to be calm. Yesterday night I had a strong shaking on my head but now it seems a bit calmer. A pain came upon me as in the past and it seemed as if my head disappeared. A certain fear and unrest were already taking over but my Good freed me. 88 I slept but I was shaken by some small beasts the sight of which gave me || boredom and they left me a certain pain, worry and fear.

But since they were not many I slept again. What suffering

I felt at the thought that they always announce certain sad events which unfortunately take place!

What a horrible night I spent yesterday night! First I had many small shadows that strolled around and they produced in me much suffering, || a horrible apprehension. 89 I was tired of the day and my head was weak. Soon the evil one took advantage and showed me that there was no more remedy and that I had lost my head. What I was doing confirmed to me that they were actions of someone who had lost her mind. My God, only you could say what kind of pain this is! Alone without human relief, overcome by tiredness I slept || but it was a deep drowsiness. 90 In this way from one o’clock after midnight I stayed until four. Finally when I woke up, I was as cold as dead and completely trembling.

Alas, what will happen to me? My God, my Love, you leave me like this without giving me help? What should I do?

I started praying and I hid myself in the wound of the side of my Good in order to have relief, but nothing; what a pain!

Hesitation in placing herself under the direction of a director

91 I remained like that || until half past five and the cold convulsion I had started to calm down. How much I suffered! How could I pray? How could I meditate? I was capable of nothing; everything was taken away from my mind. I only felt a deep unrest and it seemed that I would have sad news. And there came a company of girls: 92 who are they? Oh, how my breast breaks of anguish! || Where can I go for help? A relief, a word, no, I am alone! 93 But how much this word costs me now! While I can see clearly that it is the will of my Good to give my direction to the one I mentioned above, yet I am afraid that my Love will leave me and come no more to tell me what to do. He will no longer be there to teach me but will let me receive all instructions || from the one who will guide me. Oh, the terrifying thought that tortures my soul!

My good, why do you do this after so many years? – In this way I always go on lamenting but I realise always that it is his will.

Will you not instruct me anymore?

And when I groan much I receive caresses and nothing more.

Oh, what will become of me? I go on thinking – what will I do? 94 How will I || get used to it?

Oh, when I think of that moment in which I have to reveal everything, what a pain!

Some days ago while I was making such moaning a voice said to me:

You will have the strength and you will not lack the courage; you will be able to say everything freely.

It seemed like a dream, but if my Good said that, it will certainly happen.

“Without a guide, how bad it is!”

95 For some days I have seen the Madonnina with some black signs on her hands || and on the forehead. My God, what will happen? When it is like this for me they are bad signs of something bad which will happen to someone.

When I am overtaken by convulsion how painful I feel seeing myself so upset without knowing the reason! Oh, my Love, only you could comfort me!

96 But my infamies do not allow me to obtain anything and my love is obliged to punish me. Oh, mercy! || Only this makes me hope to obtain everything from his charity. Oh, goodness, my Love!

I am taken by much unrest. I do not know the reason but I believe that it is this complex of things that in this moment makes me suffer. I would like to force myself, but what can I do? My God, how many afflictions!

In a special way when inside the people one sees certain aspects of pretence, what a pain! || 97 In saying something one always fears failing in charity and having no one as a guide, how bad it is! I do not know if it is because of the sickness or age, but I certainly feel the tribulations strongly; they oppress me much. I believe the cause is the weakness that I feel. Oh, how much I suffer for this! 98 At every moment I feel like fainting. || I would like to be in peace, not knowing that we are on the earth of tribulations. So how could I live without cross and suffering? Oh, cruel pain to desire for penances and to be prohibited and not to have someone to whom you could ask if it was truly God who wanted it like that! My Love, tell me what I should do!

He never comes!

“Oh, Mary, send to me the one Jesus wants to be my guide!”

99 Today is the eve of the Nativity || and how could I omit disciplining myself until bleeding for Mary, my dear mother, who does very much for me? I do nothing, I live as an ass; I only offer to her eating badly, the thirst and then the sleep and nothing more; the small chain that I carry and all the mortifications, but it is nothing. Oh, at least if I could pour a bit of blood, but I fear it may be imposed on me by obedience. || 100 How can I ask? The desire is immense but the fear of disobeying prevents me. Oh, Mary, send to me the one Jesus wants to be my guide!

“I would like to shout in all the parts of the world until they all love you”

Today my side, I felt it start to make something… Mary, Mary, I would like to shout in all the parts of the world until they all love you; Unfortunately there are people who do not know you and do not want to love you. 101 Oh, it is because they do not feel what I feel || if not they would love you. Oh, tell me, what I should do so that all may love you! I suffer too much especially for those two sinners who are very obstinate; what a pain! It is horrible for me not to be able to do penances for these, I feel much pain; Mary, convert them, I am suffering much! 102 I feel much pain at the thought that they are obstinate. My God, how will they || end up? Have pity of these souls and do not forget the prayers that for many years that mother said and the tears she wept for them. May it move you to pity and they to be converted!

Fears regarding the foundation of the Third Order of the Adorers

Date: 7 September. How much suffering, my God! The agonies suffered this day, what pain!

103 The beasts that move around the bed I am lying on give me much pain and more so they leave me with a sadness || of death. In this way they show me to be prepared for a certain affair that will happen to me. This time I understood well these things. In fact, they leave me with unrest and fear but my Love will always be with me to defend me though I deserve nothing because I am a monster of infamy. 104 Alas, how can I make up || for the evil I have done? I cannot think of it! How much I suffer!

Oh, what horrible pains! To suffer and to see what that monster continues to do to torment me more! My Love, give me patience and strength. 105 I must work for the new foundation of || the Order. What I feel! Much fear, turmoil takes place in my mind; what can I do? How can I free myself? But now I cannot do it anymore. It is already far advanced and everything is concluded. Nothing remains but to ask my Good to have pity on me, to forget my wickedness and give me his teachings and his instructions. || 106 Oh, the thought of being again at the head of a Work! An ass as I am, I feel worn out and I go on saying:

How can I bear?

Alas, what am I saying, my Jesus? Oh, I realise that it is the enemy who puts me in such turmoil and shows me horrible things. 107 What I feel at the thought || that I never did something, but always my Good was pleased to do everything! I have only misery; he found me so unfit that I was not even able to say a word well, because I was ignorant without any kind of skill. When I think of this I go on repeating within me:

108 Certainly my Good will come again to || teach me.

“My Crucifix, give me the cross and you rest in this heart”

Oh, moments of paradise! All the pains become sweet in you and everything is forgotten! Only Love! Oh sweetness without equal, my Crucifix, give me the cross and you rest in this heart of yours! You made me understand very clearly that this is your desire and I embrace you without the cross, this one I hold tightly in my breast || my Love. 109 Oh, how many days should I still remain in this painful state! I suffer, I suffer! Have pity on me, send to me what you told me; the one by whom you wanted me to be directed, so that I may come out of this painful state. Mary, help me!

Today she was more beautiful and so was the Holy

110 Mother. She did not have those black signs which || left me sad and they always gave me a spasm of something that would happen. But this for the mercy of God had come to an end, Mary!

Another sign of the epidemic of cholera

How much unrest I felt this morning! Again I saw another sign of the epidemic but it was isolated. Its nearness worries me at the thought where it might be stronger. It appeared on the opposite side of the other times.

111 Oh, Mary, today was your day; || obtain for us the grace from Jesus that this scourge may come to an end and the one I saw in the morning may vanish.

There were also beasts that tormented me much; I cannot say how they left me, what convulsions and unrest! My God, what a pain! And in Holy Communion it increased. Mary, Mater gratiae et misericordiae, have pity on me!

112 Today I felt afflicted for not being able to offer || something. I was taken up so much by sadness; what will happen, my God?

The notes of 1885 are found in three consecutive notebooks of file 5 and at the beginning of file 7; these last were written apart in a retrospective manner.

The Foundress had to sustain many struggles for the good of the Institute. She accepted the direction of Father Bernardino da Portogruaro only to fulfil the will of God. The sensation of interior emptiness and of having done everything badly returned but for a short time only because soon the certainty of the direction of Jesus, made her regain the freedom of the spirit giving her light on the meaning of obedience to the spiritual director: “Submitted but not bound nor tied-up”.

On Good Friday she received light on the value of her suffering, in the double dimension of the mystery of suffering: participation in the suffering of Christ in his passion and in the present sufferings of the church. Exactly in these months the faith of Mother Rosa in the hierarchical Church, concretely in the Vatican, was subjected to new tests; Leo XIII was not accessible to her as Pius IX was.

The love of the Servant of God always eminently active now became desirous of making known to all the supreme Good and at the same time the strong preoccupation for the spiritual progress of the sisters is manifested. The death of Sister Anne del Salvatore Orsi, superior of the house of Palermo, which occurred on June 7, 1885, impressed her deeply. Between the two there was much spiritual affinity. From this moment onwards she will have her constantly close in every moment of need.

Meanwhile, she felt that some things were improving in her life: new serenity and interior peace, a union with God in a different way, interior strength when faced with difficulties and temptations were continuous as she never lacked the torment of being abandoned by God and even by the Blessed Mary. At the same time she received abundant light on the suitable criteria regarding the formation of the sisters.

In spite of the many commitments and paperworks, she found time to entrust to her notebook a rich variety of experiences and considerations. The 1885 is one of the most interesting years from the autobiographical point of view.

First he said that he wanted it for his own objectives, later because he wanted me subjected to obedience that is bitter, without comfort, demanding and severe. It is not like that of the other creatures but arid and without consolation.

“I did everything with my power. That is why I do not want a thought of support || on your direction, no. 68 You will remain under this arid obedience until it pleases me.”154

After this beautiful lesson I really recovered, up to then I was truly in agony.

I am serene. He exhorts me to write and gives me the strength because I can do it late in the evening before I go to bed; not every night but often. 69 Oh, my Love, when you want || something, everything must be done!

I thought about my incapacity to feel pain for certain things; it seemed that by this hour I must have learned that he takes care. Yes, my Beloved, it is very true that I am ignorant!

Oh, this evening my side! My ribs, what I feel!

Much repugnance to hand over the writing to the director

I was told and I saw the ring of someone who will become a Cardinal; but there is still time. Oh, what I felt when I saw it!

70 Oh, because of || much writing on this, I am tired and I have no permission to stay awake. Obedience drives me to sleep.

In these days in the lessons that I received continually from my Good he said this: I was suffering to write certain things for the one who guided me, and I would have liked that my Good would allow me not to write anymore: patience.

He said:

If he will not ask for them, you will not give him, but if he searches for them you will obey.

71 But what did I do! I feared not telling him || because I had promised to tell him everything. What can I do? After saying this, I was given obedience to write and to handover without being asked, just the words of my Good and what I saw, without narrating other things. My God, what can I do?

Well, here my Master said:

For him do what he said and for me continue as you did always.

In this way I was happy. I will take just the words of my God and nothing else. 72 You my beloved Master will teach me so that I may obey || for this is truly hard.

I find nothing hard in doing it but manifesting the things of my spirit. What a pain! Oh, blessed I call those souls who can tell everything without pain. Mary my dearest Mother obtain for me the strength to overcome myself. I cannot express the deep melancholy that I suffer and the forcing of myself so that they may not realise.

A mistaken concept of people about a person

I cannot understand how she/he could be a good soul, though all say it, but what an impression! I always keep him/her especially in mind || when I pray and meditate. 73 Oh, what will be! It gives pain, why my God, dear Master, tell me the reason.

I wish to be able to describe how in these days many skulls of dead people appeared to me; and I was unable to identify them, but they kept me busy thinking. Who could they be? If my Love would grant me to understand what he showed me! Oh, what a beatitude! The suffering of these days was joy; yes, suffering, you are very sweet! ||

“They are the sufferings the Church goes through”

74 Holy Monday: My side, I felt the pain of the scars more so than usual.

Holy Thursday 1885: I remained writing until two o’clock after midnight and then I went down to the chapel and remained there until half past four. What I suffered, my God! First I felt something that I cannot describe and I said:

Oh, my Love, what is this I am feeling?

They are the sufferings the Church goes through!155

It was a sea of turmoil of every kind, agony; a very strong shaking took me, sharp pains came along on the folding of the arms. What spasm! 75 I felt || the dislocation of the bones and it was so strong that I was unable to bear it and I yielded:

My Good, have pity, what does this mean?

They are the pains that I suffered in the crucifixion while I was nailed on the cross.

Oh, suffering! I lay with difficulty and it continued so that I felt sick; the arms were swollen; the hands, the nerves were all so stretched that I moved them with difficulty. 76 This remained until holy Saturday morning and I stayed the whole day until late night. The swelling || disappeared but I had a terrible night.

Afflictions she experienced in Vatican

I was always frightened by strong noises while sleeping and felt a strong impulse as a strong voice said:

Do not go to the Vatican this morning; there is nothing but confusion.

But the fear of being mistaken halted me. What I suffered, only you could say it!

There was a moment in which I felt like fainting. After

Holy Communion Jesus comforted me much. At first I was displeased because the Pope did not come. After having received the Holy Communion I 77 felt such a union … but I did not lose the senses, no, || since this was my fear; instead Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament appeared to me in the monstrance and it stayed before me for quite some time. Oh, my Love, yes, you are more than the Pope because he represents you and you are the real one. Oh, what I felt! I suffered because I was disturbed; I suffered but I also enjoyed much.156

Even today I felt pain in one arm. The nerves were not yet settled, and it was an arm already ruined but now, every time I move it, I feel the creaking of a nerve and the pain is felt in the breast. || 78 The other one which is the right hand is better; while I write and when I lift up something I feel pain but it is bearable.

Lessons of Jesus on obedience

What beautiful lessons my Good gave me on obedience! He wanted me to be submissive in everything, even for the journeys. How I must seek him, what I should say to fulfil this treasure of obedience. In these days my pains are numberless. This evening in a leap he showed me what one person would have suffered and from whom he would receive the arrow-shot; I was feeling the same pain, poor! ||

79 Today is 11 April 1885. He never expects, but my side assured me, and how the ribs were raised and how my side was! My God! My dear Love, my Jesus, I felt a grip to see the suffering of that person. How painful to see people suffer for slanders!

Jesus: “Instead of my Vicar, I am here”

I went to the Vatican where the Holy Father was expected for the Holy Communion. However, because of indisposition he did not come and instead we were received by the Cardinal Secretary of State. 80 At the end of the || Holy Communion the Venerable, Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament appeared to me. Oh, my Love! What did he say?

Instead of my Vicar I am here!

He told me many beautiful things and he comforted me much. I always hear a certain chatter which announces a strong affliction but I am not able to understand neither which person will cause it nor which side it will come from. However, it will surely come, I am waiting for it. Mary, my Mother, come to my help!

81 I saw other stars; these always come as usual to announce the death of sisters and I saw one big one || but it was still far away. My God, this is a superior, alas!

I also saw a skull, and as usual I was not able to distinguish who it was.

“Jesus made me feel that he desired a very exact obedience from me”

What a beautiful soul is Father da Casoria!157 Oh, how he is great in heaven and prays for P.G.

I am under a hard trial; how much I suffer! On all sides

I see an abyss of sufferings. I would like to hold them tight and embrace them with joy but this miserable ass does not cooperate at all, it twists. 82 Oh, only the will remains firm and it is united to the spirit! This pig is subjected || by force.

Jesus my Love made me feel that he desired a very exact obedience from me. He told me what I should say to my guide even what he wanted to be subjected to obedience.

My God, what a pain to see that I am unable to be understood by a religious about a certain affair regarding the good of a soul!

83 Only God could see the pain I felt for two sinners that I never see || converted a bit. It seemed to me to have the grace and then I saw an abyss and I do not know where it finished and what it contained.

My Love, what a pain, have pity of these two souls!

Ecstasy with the experience of the Eucharistic food

Today while I did my usual prayers, I was enraptured or rather absorbed in God.

What I felt! My side was in its Good as enraptured; it seemed to me that the Holy Host entered my side. In my intellect I saw very well that it was much better than life itself.

84 Oh, what strength I received! Everything disgusted me even the food. || If it were not to avoid admiration I would have eaten nothing for I was feeling so much strengthened and what I saw was always before me.

However, as soon as this ceased, there came something which announced new tribulation. My Jesus my Love, give me yourself to bear such a torturing suffering because certainly without your strength, I am a rag.

Prevision of the Pope that will succeed Leo XIII

In these days I had a beautiful lesson and more so a strong union; during the day and at night, I felt a certain snatches in my side and soon I was united || with my Good. 85 Oh, in the union with his side what I felt this morning! My God, beloved Love!

He made me understand the Pope who will succeed this one. Oh, terrible sight! But he will stay for a short time. The other one will be a saint158 and he will do great things for our Catholic Church. I saw this Cardinal who pretended to be holy and promising… but it was all pretence in order to achieve his intent. But dear Jesus will allow him for his own just goals.

Sisters who make a nest in themselves being closed to the superiors

86 I saw in the || heart of a sister who had certain mistaken opinions.

Oh, how this gloomy spirit ruins the poor sisters, because when it is able to possess them in this sad manner it carries them to despair. It confuses the head and the conscience for it puts in mind many ideas to induce them to abandon their vocation. 87 They think it is holiness to be silent especially with the superiors and this is || a real mistake even for the one who guides them and exhorts them to keep quiet. Many times what they keep as a mystery is nonsense, and when they share it with the superiors everything disappears.

Although they are responsible for their faults, everything which happens to them is because they are destined to suffer and to keep quiet. Horror! 88 There is the evil spirit and how I see it clearly.

To see what it does in those hearts || afflicts me much.

How much pain! I would like to find the way to make them understand that they are deceived and more so, woe betide me if they are provoked much! What silent weeping and what outburst with the sisters! But what does this bring?

They see everything lacking in the others, it is only they who do well, the others, do not lead a life of holiness, only themselves.

89 They look at the superiors with eyes of indifference and little by little they form wrong ideas. || They go to confession and believe one thing instead of another because they carry it as they want.

My God, why do you want me to write this while I am not able to explain myself?

Certainly if I could write the things as I see them what beautiful lessons there could be! My Good gives no other science but this; I am very happy for everything.159

Obedience in the long absence of the confessor

I feared, because I saw a person who had bad feelings towards the Work, but my Good will take care. 90 How oppressed I am and taken || by much interior fear that I cannot describe. It only gives me much pain.

From the time that the one who guided me left, my Good has guided me in everything; in this way he teaches me to obey in peace as he told me to tell the guide. Before, it seemed impossible to live under an exact obedience and stay months without a word on it. But the infinite wisdom of my Good brought it to the easiest way of execution. || 91 He had organised everything so well that there is no need that I see or speak materially with the person but every morning I have the obedience. Everything, even the smallest things, are ordered by him. Not only for many months but even for years I could stay in this way; I would only be happy knowing that I am under the most exact obedience.160

Certain things can happen only with my God. One cannot experience such beatitude apart from him. 92 Oh, my Love, how painful || to see certain souls who find their consolation only in the confessor! Oh, my Love, how should I thank you because I have never found any consolation apart from you. If these souls could experience for an instant such consolation that I feel, they would certainly have no need of anyone. They would only need it for obedience and nothing else.

Oh, what a pain to see them so mean in love and in detachment from all! ||

93 My sweet Love is again as close to me as before. He provides me with his strength and in detaching myself from the least things I feel and see nothing else but him and in him only the pains of every kind which are balm to me.

The goodbye to the chapel of Rome
