I suffered a lot in this journey, because as usual my side in such movement pains a lot. My sweet Love, I am rewarded very well! 94 In the midst of all the affairs of your Work, it did not seem me that I could experience even || the smallest pain.

Oh, what I feel when I go to your presence! What do I say? The presence of my Love is something continuous for me. Oh, dear Good!

I went to the chapel of Rome to say goodbye. As soon as I knelt at the foot of the altar and at the thought that I was leaving him that evening, what I felt! He said: “If you go away even me, I will go”; what a pain to leave! 95 I felt a grip of weeping; however I was quick to turn away || and go.

What a pain, my Love; I want only you, my joy!

These days I saw various small stars moving around me.

The pain in my arm, after the dislocation on the left arm, always gives me certain spasms … It seems that the nerves are not yet all right, they always creak and give me spasms.

96 If I am not very careful the arm remains twisted and if I try to pick something I risk throwing it to the ground. ||

“Desire nothing, except suffering and love”

Siena: I find myself in the midst of a heap of work and alone with my Beloved, but I am not alone, what can I say? I have the whole world with me because my dear Jesus, my sweet love, is with me. This evening he interrupted me in discussions. Perhaps they would have not been continued without risk of failing in charity. But my Good had compassion on me; he confused me in a way that I had to stop interrupting. ||

97 In this way, immediately I felt consolation because I was able to see that everything was said well and I failed in nothing. But if I could describe the manner in which he stopped me, one could clearly see that it was the work of the sweet Love.

The thought that is the sight of the horrible depth of the fault frightened me. Oh, I do not want to think anymore but I thank my Good who || removed it away.

98 He left me with one thought: not to desire anything except suffering and love; suffering in order to please my sweet Love and nothing else. It is distancing from all the creatures, these I see in my Good, but I suffer if I must converse with them. I only rejoice when I can be charitable with them. I desire nothing for myself, I do not wish a word of comfort, no, no! ||

99 I am happy when I am with my Good and in the lessons he gives me I find all the delights of my life.

Obedience has become very sweet

I work out of an arid obedience, as my Good said, but for me it has become very sweet. It is as if I have a sweet direction, everything becomes easy for me; I find nothing difficult. I act everything in my Good.

100 On Sunday I had certain moments in which || I seemed to find myself in one of our chapels where my Good was exposed and a good soul prayed for me and made others pray. Oh, how well I felt in that church and in that house! Oh, if I could express how I felt! To be together with those dear 101 sisters, especially the superior who knew how to obtain many things for me! Oh, beloved soul of my dear Love, || what sweetness is felt!

A letter to a sister who was a victim of false spiritual feeling

Today 1st May 1885. I cannot describe the joy I felt in having received a very beautiful lesson from my dear Master.

He showed me the interior of a good Daughter of St. Anne who felt a certain suffering for the passion of the Saviour and this was very sensible. But there was another aspect, which she also revealed to the confessor. My God, how the confessor was easily mistaken! 102 He should have been firm in not heeding. || He was not. The enemy returned to assault her and was happy and pleased. Well, she tried to deny what she experienced but I clearly saw the effects.

103 In this way my sweet Master made me write to that person out of obedience and I can say everything was dictated to me. Now that a few hours have passed from the time I sent the letter, I wanted to put in paper what I wrote but I see I cannot do it with that clarity which was || in the letter.

Oh, my sweet Love, what joy I feel in having done what you desired, though I felt much pain and also some repugnance!

In addition a strong feeling kept me bound because the guide of that creature was good and wise.

I think my sweet Love wanted to make his ass speak.

Oh, my Love only you!

The badness of the evil serpent is without equal. 104 Many find themselves encumbered in the spirit || because they always rely on sensible things and live aside the true serious behaviour. When I see such creatures I feel pain for them. I see strolling of small stars; what will it mean?

In these days I feel an unusual strength and that something beautiful will happen to me… Oh, my Love, I do not want anything but you and to live and be consumed in you.

105 Having done the writing || after some time I spoke to the person to whom I wrote. Oh, how much she appreciated and she thanked me much for what I wrote!

She remained satisfied and serene.161

Two sisters in purgatory. New signs of cholera.

Battle with a Bishop

I met my guide, Mary, how I kept everything confused in my mind, because a long time has passed without being able to write! The journeys… Oh, my sweet Love!

Last evening, I saw a sister near my bed and I asked her who she was. She answered:

Sister Anne of Jesus.

106 I promised to offer for her the Holy Communion. ||

After she told me that she was in purgatory and she suffered much.

She also told me another name: Teresa, but I did not get well. I thought that was her name when she was a lay person, but I did not understand well. I felt very sorry for her, poor creature!

On the night of 17 May 1885, again I saw signs of an epidemic towards the west that left me so confused seeing how it was spread. My God, even this year we will still have the disease! I understood that was France, || last year the same thing happened. 107 My God, have pity on us!

Today I had to fight with a Bishop, but the words which came from my lips were such that it was a pleasure to listen to what my Good said; that was truly the case of an donkey.

“My sweetest Love, how can I make you known by the whole world?”

108 In this month, I cannot number what my Good worked in me, but I had no time to write down. There was also the passing of the stars, the skulls of death, and instructions on what || I had to do. If I had time, I could have written a volume.

Tell me, my sweetest Love, how can I make you known by the whole world? What pain this is!

The sight of that abyss which brought me horror ceased; it seemed that it is me who committed everything I saw. I am now free since my Good has made me feel that this will come back no more. 109 I feel peace and calm. || Moreover in the adversities, I feel calm without equal. Though I put forth much effort, I cannot utter the words with zeal. What a grace, my sweet Love!

I feel there is in me one who does and say everything; he notes for me the smallest things.

I see calmness in all that I do, a perfect abandonment in the hands of God for all that happens to me.

110 My side is as usual, the union || with my Love increases the pleasure of holy poverty. I am hungry to work for the glory of God and the charity of my neighbour; I would do everything in order to relieve the poor sick and advance the salvation of souls. When someone tells me: “You saved me; I was in the abyss and you saved me,” what I feel my God! This is all my delight and my comfort in the work, in the toil; but everything is for my dear and sweet Saviour.

MS 5. 4 – pp. 1 – 116

“I fought more than ever, I won in the spirit but the body failed me”

29 May 1885. 1 The continued tribulations – and they are felt very much by those who are sensible – debilitated me and today this ass fainted. Oh, how much I had suffered. I saw clearly the diabolic work and how much anger the enemy of hell had against the Work of the Lord. I sustained the battle with strength; the fear of being alone…

This ass could not bear the anxiety; I battled more than ever, I won in the spirit but the body failed me. Terrible work!

2 The confusion that the enemy suggested || to me was that my untiring work, was damnation and I should end it once and for all and retire to think of my soul.

For this reason the apprehension was strong and I was unable to free myself. I do not stay to describe what astute words it added to convince me. Oh, my Love!

3 This took place (I experienced it always) when the Institute had to have greater development. Even now the dragon roars || and the beast of my body is never used to reason. When this happens it twists furiously. Tribulations, strong union, knowledge of spiritual things, lessons of the Lord

Last night towards one o’clock after the usual passage now of one and then of another, two coat of arms appeared to me. One was dark blue with golden stars, the other one, a heart, an oval in the middle and then a mixture at the back; I do not know how to explain them. 4 The first remained stationed longer near my bed, while the other one, soon ran away, as if the one who carried it had to run away. The victor was the one of the star, very beautiful || and the crown was real. I was not able to understand any thing; for sure, in the future I will have the explanation.

In these days life seems to be a river that overflows, such are the tribulations of every kind. My Good left me a bit in interior darkness. But for my side there were moments in which the union I felt with my sweet Love was so strong that my bones… My God, only you could describe what my side does and feels.

5 For several days I have felt someone present and it seems to me || she is very ill-treated that I feel pity.

Every time that I start meditating on the passion, I find myself near the tabernacle, near my holy and sweetest Love.

Oh, yes, here, if I could describe what I feel on my side in this sweet union… I remained entire hours and I felt thrust, the fire, and the knowledge of certain spiritual things for other souls and for me the sensible pleasure for whatever pertains to humility; the keenness of being humiliated and the lively desire of being despised by all.

6 It is a joy which cannot be expressed || to be able to hide everything so that all may have nothing but pity in bearing with me so mean as I am and of this I think with conviction; I feel that I am so mean that I am ashamed of myself.

How many beautiful lessons I received regarding what is to be done in the Work and in these days I always received notices and teachings as to what I should do.

Oh, my sweetest Love, wisest Master! 7 Yes, I can say to be the true ass of Balaam or the ass of your Work, because

I am so ignorant || that I am unable of saying well a word, if he, my Saviour and Master, does not teach me.

Good hope for the Sons of St. Anne

Last night, many beasts of all types strolled in my room! The same was for the small stars for the Daughters of St. Anne; one was big and blue, sign of a good soul but lay.

How my Good goes on preparing the Sons of St. Anne is something great and extraordinary. I saw what went on in a person who should have been the one to help me, but he is not generous in answering the call and fears; he will do something but not everything.162 ||

Assault of the enemy to prevent the approval of the Institute. Vision of St. Anne

8 Last night 7 June1885, from midnight until one o’clock, I saw the strolling of beasts. Among many there was a white one and it disappeared to the north. I understood well everything: that ugly monster made uproar and today from the letters I had I was not mistaken that it was the one, the dragon of hell that roared. It knows that the last approval is being asked of Rome; that is why it does whatever it can to prevent it. I do not want to think of it ugly rag, you must break down. How it roars || against the Work of the Lord! 9 Even today, it continued doing all kinds of mischief.

After these filthy beasts passed I slept a bit but again, I had other pains, noises and strong unrest that were unbearable. Towards morning I drowsed and I seemed to be before the Holy Mother St. Anne, (she seemed to be speaking with St. Joseph). He left and I remained with her. I asked her what she said about a person and her way of living and she answered:

In the past she behaved badly but now she had improved.

10 She would have cared herself. I remained very serene, || but I saw many signs of uproar and fierce persecutions. She said that her Institute would have suffered nothing because, though young, it rested before the saint in deep sleep and there was nothing that could wake it up, no.

Vision of the Virgin Mary with a box of sweets

11 For two days I have been unable to rest because of the continuous passage of beasts but they are not as before. They do not have legs, no; they are like black pieces without head and legs, now in one way and then in another but always black pieces as scoundrels. There was one || that had certain round clear things like coins. In fact I had a big issue of interest. One piece was made as a big mitre and after this there was a beautiful star, but blue, of a lay person.

This morning I prayed much for a house in which there were some disorders because of the superior. I received Holy

Communion in honour of the Virgin Mary and she comforted me. While I remained absorbed, I saw the Virgin handing me a beautiful box of sweets. I distributed part of it to all and the beautiful ones to the children. 12 On the other part, there were

|| beautiful, big and white sweets, but these I did not distribute; I kept them covered for myself. This vision left me so happy as if I had obtained everything. My joy, sweet Mary!

After much suffering for many months which seemed like a tempest, there were many sufferings, my Love. What a pain to see you betrayed by the one you benefited most! It is very true that the wound a heart can receive is betrayal. At the end of this she made me aware of many things including what I must do this morning… ||

“I seemed to have the whole world upon me!”

13 This evening while I was in the garden, I thought about two Daughters of St. Anne who were gravely ill.

My God, for pity’s sake, heal them for me! - I said.

There two stars came: one was big. The other one was small and went to heaven; it was forty- five past seven. What pain I felt!

Now it is late at night and I feel a strong melancholy which gives me pain; neither the discipline until bleeding nor the prayers are for me a relief as I write.

Oh, my Love, what agony you made me feel! Always death! I cannot bear it any more. I seem to have the whole world upon me… ||

The anxieties, 14 the sufferings of these days make me feel a fever and at every moment I think I am going to faint. Feeling small and nothing and yet comforted by my sweet love, I fear having displeased him.

News of the death of Sister Anne del Salvatore, 7 June 1885

On 7 June I was feeling melancholy and every now and then I fainted. What will happen? 15 On 7 June, in the afternoon, towards evening, a soul going to heaven appeared to me; together with this there was another and they seemed to be two || or perhaps if she was trying to reach another soul. I cannot explain what I felt. Oh, blessed soul, why did you go so early to heaven leaving me in this sea of sufferings?

She was my comfort. Oh, how she was gifted with divine lights. She had the gift of prophecy; everything she asked of Blessed Mary, she obtained; her union with God was strong. Anything that I asked of her, she had a ready reply and it was the right one. She had a profound humility; 16 she always considered herself as the most infamous of || creatures. Oh, how great she was in the sight of God! Oh, sweet love!

My dear Sister Anne del Salvatore:163 I remember those long evenings I spent in her company, always speaking of things of the sweet Love! Patience! May the will of my Good be done in everything!

After Holy Communion while I prayed, - this evening was for Sister Anne del Salvatore – I asked her to give me proof that the light which moved around me was herself who went to heaven. 17 I asked that this proof be clear like much providence or another grace that I had asked for over a long time. || She appeared to me and said:

Today this sum will arrive (that was what happened);

the grace that you desire you will have soon.

Smiling and raising the hand she made a sign of assurance. I asked her about the health of certain people and she said:

Be calm, they will always be well.

I had also asked her another thing, that she may come and tell me certain things. She answered:

I cannot come.

However, she did not tell me the reason and at the end she left me very calm that was without compare.

18 Oh, beautiful soul, who finished suffering much || and already enjoy the reward of your immense sufferings and anguishes!

In obedience she felt peace and resignation

My God, are the present sufferings not enough? How much more I saw last night! In the same way today I saw many skulls. One was at the end of my legs, at the back of the bed, over the blanket and facing towards me. What a pain! It must be a person who belongs to me.

I saw other tribulations of every kind. My God, give me strength to bear them because they || are many.

19 It is true that for the burning thirst of suffering that I always have is dear to me; but this pig feels unable to bear it, overburdened by the immense tribulations. It seems there is fire on all sides; my God, have pity, give me strength for your Work! Alone with no one to whom to say a word; with you my Good I give vent to my suffering. I desire nothing else but you, my Love, and the obedience which I receive in spirit every morning || from the time you gave me… 20 yes, my Love, my sweet Saviour, I do not want anything but obedience and in it I find peace and resignation.

Nothing becomes a burden to me under dear holy obedience! I see this to be new and so sublime because from the guide it is communicated to me through his most divine Spirit. I am sure that everything that I do is under the virtue of holy obedience. ||

Many hours in table writing: “It is my duty”

21 The fire of my side, the outburst that I feel from my poor ribs! What pain I feel to remain many hours in table writing! But this is my duty, my beloved is happy and when my arm pains because the ribs rise out of the swelling that I always have, my Good, what a sweet pain I feel; sweetest Jesus! Oh, what I feel!

22 I then stand up to distract myself, for the hand as in this moment pains and I feel || torture in the whole of myself, as if a great affliction is coming. My God pity!

“I do not understand myself; I feel an interior peace… the union with God is different”

What new sufferings! I do not understand myself: I feel inner peace, no reproaches; I no longer see the horrible abyss. But my prayer is arid and dry. I hardly feel raptures and my union with God is different. 23 I do not understand the reason, unless my Good gives me the explanation of this state. I find myself, so to speak, like a soul between the light and the dark, not knowing || where it is: it proceeds without knowing where it is going; it lets itself be guided as if by an unknown guide. I do not feel the wrench that threw me into anguish; I do not even feel the terrible pains, because my sweet Love tells me nothing. Now, I wait with peace and resignation for his arrival.

Yes! My Love will come and will take me out of this starvation and will teach me what to do to rise up; I do not doubt it. He will give me the strength to rise up again.

The soul of Sister Anne del Salvatore “still in purgatory”

24 I was not mistaken, the soul of… is still in purgatory, not in pain but deprived of God’s sight. || I saw her veiled with black, the light was dim; she was unable to speak much to me but she informed me that soon I will have what I asked for.

Today there was a moment in which she was so close to me and she consoled me. She seemed to assure me that soon I will have the much desired grace.

Yesterday, while I was going to bed for a while because

I suffered and I was not able to stand on my feet, at the back of the bed, down on my feet there was a skull of a dead person. 25 Oh, what pain it caused me! ||

The same was for the continuous passage of the stars;

first small ones, then big ones and there are also good souls of the lay people who move around me.

Support of obedience she received every day from the spiritual father

Today I was in the church doing a bit of meditation and I do not know if it was union or meditation. 26 A man who from his appearance seemed to be a distinguished person came close to me as if asking for help; at the end I was able to make out his image because he stayed for quite some minutes and then || disappeared. For sure I cannot affirm who he is, but

I could say that from the way he looked at me, he will defend the Work. My God, only obedience is my comfort. Oh, my sweet Love, you well knew the tribulations that are happening now!

It is a new state of suffering and agony, but the obedience that every day I receive in the spirit from my spiritual father supports me and safeguards me. Yes, my God, I intend to work || for obedience. 27 If I make a mistake it is up to my guide to correct me. My Love, have pity on me!

I have a strong thought that whatever I do is badly done and that I ruin your Work! No, if it will be like that my guide will remedy. No, I breathe for the Work and I live and work for you, my Good.

“Painful and awful suggestion of becoming insane”

Yesterday I suffered immensely because that painful and awful fear of becoming insane returned me. 28 My God, || it was so strong and with astute incitement it almost convinced me that I was already insane; everything was done without criteria, and in one word, there was no remedy. My poor head suffered for two days. The only relief I could find was to distract myself in any possible way. But woe betides me when I started thinking or speaking! 29 At the end the suffering was so much that I cannot describe it; I prayed but nothing. ||

In the evening and still worse at night, my torment was terrible.

The need of having the Sons of St. Anne

How much need I see for the Sons of St. Anne! What grief it gives me to see these poor creatures guided by different spirits, so that one tends to withdraw, another gives too much rein and they become dissipated.

And my inner voice tells me:

Get to work, they will help you.

It tells me many other things, but I feel such an enormous reluctance that I cannot even think about it. 30 It is so strong, it overcomes me. What can I do my Love? ||

I shall wait for obedience and I shall submit to it; with the strength that I receive from the same, I will do everything, my Love.

Angelic purity of Sister Anne del Salvatore. Her charity

Unfortunately in these days deaths will take place because I saw skulls. How many have already taken place!

That one of the blue star did not yet happen; unfortunately it will not delay.

Last night, a bandage a bit longer that a meter and twenty centimeters wide appeared to me; it halted in the air and while I looked at it a voice said:

This was the bandage I kept, the sign they saw on my heart.

31 The lesson || that I was given was beautiful! How Jesus had preserved her with this from the least sentiment: her body was completely dead, she understood nothing of impropriety or rather she understood everything but she kept nothing. She saw the dread of sin and did not know what it meant. Oh, what a mystery was explained to me! Now I understand how great that grace is and also the grace I have always had but in a different way: the body and the senses were dead but the intellect understood the malice of sin.

32 My God, || I regret not having written everything properly. Oh, how my side was raised and the ribs as usual and I remained very drowsy.

As I returned to where I was, I remained fully in God.

Oh, dear soul, you promised me a grace which I will soon have. I wait for it!

Last night I prayed to this dear daughter Sister Anne del

33 Salvatore, so that she may obtain for me the healing of a benefactor who was sick. || She assured me that he will be healed and showed me that he will not only regain health but he would be healthier than before and I saw him very fat and calm; he will live long. I remained so sure and I felt an interior cheerfulness united with a certainty…

All the doubts and the thoughts vanished in this way today I spoke of him.

There was always a beautiful light moving around me, very beautiful and much brighter and bigger than when Sister Anne del Salvatore died. I spoke and she went around feasting. Oh, dear daughter! ||

34 I had certain thoughts while I was in the church today that a person could be sick with a bad sickness. I recommended to her and she showed me that it would go somewhere else so that it may not do any bad to anybody. Dear soul, she suffered much and always atrociously. She desired only the others’ wellbeing and that no one may suffer. What charity without limit! ||

Cold water baths to calm the fire of love

35 My God, my Love, who will die? I see nothing but death. I say this because the stars which move around me are many. On all sides wherever I look there is a star. My Love, what snatches I felt on my side in these days!

Oh, what a pain to restrain, to feel faint and to be silent for the fear that they may realise. 36 The fire devoured me and I run to water. Only cold water baths gave me strength to resist. ||

Helpful intercession of Sister Anne del Salvatore, “a beautiful soul drenched with charity”

Today has been a day of suffering; I only had the comfort of my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore who comforted me in many things, telling me to be calm. Oh, the sight of this dear daughter is very much one of comfort and of help to me! I ask her everything as when she was here on earth among us. She answers me with short words or with signs. 37 If there is still time she signals to me raising a hand and makes a sign for waiting. Oh, beautiful soul, drenched with charity! || Even now from paradise you make one feel this gift of yours!

Today I saw that the Rule will soon be approved. Oh, what a consolation! She knows of everything that takes place; how much concern she had for the whole Institute! What a dear creature!164

An abyss of every kind of sufferings.

“My Good has completely abandoned me”

The tribulations are without compare; this evening I saw an abyss of every kind of sufferings and if I must absorb them all… Oh, certainly I cannot stand them and I feel much weight that is unbearable. My God, what a fright!

38 It is the first time that I feel disheartened; || I have no strength to bear it. I seem to be like a tree shaken by a tempest which brings trembling upon me. All the smallest things shake my poor ass which has nothing but pains. I always have a headache; continually I receive very strong head-knocks and I do not know how to defend against them. I always try to run to the feet of my dear Crucifix to pray that he may give me strength and hide me in his most holy wounds. ||

39 Nothing helps me, for I cannot say a word to anybody else about my state.

My guide is no where, I cannot send him a line; I have only the arid obedience.

Oh, days of tribulation on all sides and the cruelest are those which I receive from… Oh, you my Love could say what agony this is! With out comfort, I am someone who suffers and knows not what to do to get up because there is nothing that could raise me. This is how I am poor miserable creature. ||

40 My Good has completely abandoned me. The sky is of bronze for me. He left me only the sight of sufferings and I see standers, sisters who leave off their veil, others do not behave well and still others who complain…

Houses which could do well suffer because of lack of observance of the superior.

Another sight is that of my ecclesiastical superiors who are angry because they received things unjustly reported. || 41 Some people try to do harm to the Work in different ways.

There are deaths of all kinds; many sisters and benefactors and also others who did good for the Work died.

It is a bitter war moved by that enemy of hell and I see it roaring. Discussions on my family…it would take much to describe everything that I see and unfortunately it is happening. It is a dread! || 42 I am also completely in the dark; when I turn to my sweet Love I find nothing, neither comfort nor peace. It is a tempest of diabolic suggestions. It tells me of things oppressing me strongly until that terrible temptation of becoming mad returns to me. 43 Oh, this really brings me a pain without compare! Oh, one who did not experience this temptation certainly cannot know what torture means: desolation. The subtleness || it uses to show me that it is true and that there is no hope is the cruelest torture.

I did not feel such torment since I saw that horrible abyss and yet it was not as painful as this. In that state I could weep and the suffering was as a comfort for the things I saw. 44 But for this one, no; the tribulation is dry and arid, without support. I have only a strong trembling and I faint. ||

“Today I felt strong, I felt no pain”

The tribulations had increased, but today for me it was different: I felt strong enough to challenge the whole world and it did not impress me. A look at my dear Crucifix, he also remained in suffering. As for me I am happy to suffer for his Work.

Today I felt strong; I felt no pain; no, no. Your love my sweet Good! I was happy, what a joy! 45 Beat, but you will not overcome against God. || No one could make it.

In Holy Communion I understood everything and felt in need of nothing.

Today hearing all the accusations, how I remained happy and joyful, as if they did nothing to me. Again I saw my beloved daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore who assured me that I will receive the grace. Oh, my Love, this will suffice for everything.

Beasts and other signs of night, but there is the interior strength

46 Last night, I was tired and unable to stand anymore because of the pains and it was very late but I was unable to sleep. When I was || half-asleep a beast shook me. Where was this? It was on the iron of the bed, with certain legs and black as charcoal. It was many months since I had seen these beasts and I thought they had lost the track of me; not at all!

They were seen again! What will happen to me? In addition to what is already there, I do not know what type could still come. 47 Unfortunately they will happen; let the || will of God be done in everything.

Big and small stars and finally all kinds of things which signify disaster were there.

If I could narrate everything sad and painful which I saw in these days I would not finish. But today I felt a certainty united with interior strength; I wait for something beautiful and great for the Work of the Holy Mother St. 48 Anne. Dear

Jesus is pleased in his Work and supplies it with great things;

he uses the || most miserable means that could ever be found and of this ass capable of doing nothing good, only ruining and nothing more.

The effective help of Sister Anne del Salvatore

Some days ago I prayed to my dear Sister Anne del

Salvatore. Oh, what a dear daughter and how she assisted me! I thought I had lost her and with that not be able to ask her for a word; but she is always with me, and I could say more than before; when I ask her for something, she answers me so clearly that I have no doubt and soon I see the effects.

49 I asked her if she had healed || a person who was very interesting for the Institute. She answered:

She will be very well!

News came of that person and she was very well. I had received replies for other graces of this type. Of one she said:

For now she will not die but she will not recover from that sickness.

I asked her about other things and I received an answer for everything. For the arrival of the sisters of America she said:

Between fifteen and twenty.

For another thing she said:

On Saturday.

50 At the end about a grace for which I was seeking an answer she said nothing and I asked her for another one which I could obtain first. She told me about the last one, that I could have it for the feast of St. Anne. ||

Oh, how many things I ask her and she gives me an answer for everything. Oh, my dear angel! What days of tribulation!

They are of all kinds, how much they oppress me and I do not know why; while I could say that I am so resigned and interiorly I feel an extraordinary peace, and yet the unrest that I feel is so strong that for some entire days I feel agonising. Today the whole day was like this; what a pain to work with a threat of fainting.

Unrest and night sufferings

51 One of these nights || was terrible. I went to bed very late and tired. There came a skull and then certain shadows which put everything into revolution. But at two o’clock in the morning my hands seemed to be burning. I found some relief when I bathed them.

52 The weariness grew and I felt like fainting: voices, din, every kind of unrest was in the room || and it continued for the whole night. I woke up and I was unable to stand on my feet.

Oh, my Love – I went on saying – what did I do? Why these pains? Oh, my sweet Good, have pity on me! How will I work tomorrow? Oh, my strength, Jesus my beloved, what pains!

For many nights I have endured such suffering that I fear not being able to resist. I do not describe it because it seems by now it is some thing that I have learned enough about.

53 Last night at one, I was || half-asleep, when a shaking woke me up. There was a beast that looked like a black ball.

It had a stick which it held as if in the mouth, though I did not see the mouth. I saw the stick that was big and it was coming to beat me on the head. I started to laugh for the manner in which it was made and how it held the stick… I laughed and then I started thinking. Who could be the one who wants to beat me? Well, the important is that he/she does not break my head. ||

Vision of a globe of fire with two black signs

54 I am always assisted by my dear Sister Anne del

Salvatore. Yesterday she was very cheerful; I came to know the reason after: there was a sister who finally decided to obey because her resistance was a cause of much suffering but there was something more. She had other good things and graces she obtained over a long time which I did not write. Today I feel driven to write what happened last night.

55 4 august: I suffered much, and lying as usual I recited the rosary but I was feeling some thing || that kept me drowsy.

At midnight, I was shaken and I saw a big globe of fire, a dazzling light. While I looked at it a voice said to me:

This and all the graces it contains are for you; but you will not have them until those two black signs which are seen in the globe are removed. One was small but the other one was very big; 56 what I felt could not be expressed, joy flooded my soul, but I thought: ||

What will it be? What should I do?

I always thought: my sweet Love, what should I do? I am so weak and worn out; what do I have that does not please you? Take it away and I will be happy to feel the pain in this pig of my body which cannot bear anymore. But in Holy Communion an interior voice said to me:

There are tribulations that you must still go through in order to have all those graces held in the globe.

57 The consolation I felt was very much and I still || feel the effects though twenty four hours have passed.

Aridity and other sufferings.

The thought of the Sons of St. Anne

Today I was able to pray after more than twenty days. What I suffered was something terrible and unbelievable for I was forcing myself to enter the church. What pains my God, what suffering! So many kinds of evil assailed me that I was forced to come out. 58 Only at Holy Communion I was able to concentrate as usual but even at this time one morning this kind || of torment came to frighten me.

I am not able to narrate everything that happened to me in these days and months because I did not find time to write a line since the suffering added to the work was strong. I could not have a breath and in the exhaustion of strength of which I suffer, how I feel my Love! But it is also true that my sins prevent me from receiving many graces.

59 The thought of the Sons of St. Anne gives me much pain || because I fear it may happen as it did with the daughters…

Unfortunately I see this is the work of the devil; but this miserable ass does not want to have anything to do; it is knocked from all sides and a continuous voice whispers to me:

Start the Work and you will be comforted.

But what can I do? I am alone, alone! My guide does not sustain me.

60 My Good, have pity on me, I do not refuse, no, but I will always ask you for help and at least you trace for me the way; as ignorant as I am || I will follow you. Oh, my Love, I do not know what I should do; if you want this Work of the Sons of St. Anne, give me a helper.

Diabolic suggestions and other sufferings

On 12 August at midnight and the whole of that night the temptation or rather the diabolic suggestion of being already really mad, and that there was no remedy took me strongly with lively symptoms. I was already talking nonsense and I was not able to gather, well, a thought or a || correct thought. What suffering! 61 The interior torture was unbearable. I did not know what to do; first from one side and then from the other side of the room it was something I could not bear because my pig fainted; it seemed a serpent and it twisted. What a fright!

At four I wanted to go out of the room to ask for help but I stayed for a while. I saw that my nerves calmed and I stopped. 62 At six after the time of getting up, I calmed a bit and || I remained like that, I think, for an hour. My God, how can

I wake up? My bones were broken and I was feeling something so strong that I was unable to wake up. I forced myself and finally I woke up but what a day of suffering!

Every now and then I had a strong nervous unrest because I saw the sisters doing the Spiritual Exercises did not amend themselves and those homilies were useless for them, for they had soaked || their hearts in worldly things… what a pain!

63 I went to the Blessed Virgin to ask her that she may accept my suffering, and the agony I felt every now and then for their conversion.

Blessed Virgin, sweetest mother, accept my pains and save these souls because if they continue in this way, they will be lost. Oh, Mother, have pity once more on these unfortunates! My mother St. Anne, obtain for me this grace! Oh, do you have heart to let them perish! Take care!

64 My Mother, I suffer and I cannot bear it anymore. It is Satan who keeps me this way; || I am well convinced, so that I may not say a word to these creatures.

And it was true, what a pain!

Much union with God.

Change in the sisters who did the Spiritual Exercises

Last night, eve of the Assumption, this state continued until ten; I lay down in bed disheartened. At eleven when I felt a bit relieved I woke up and I found it increased. I disciplined myself reciting an Ave maris stella and then I continued with other prayers all dear to the Blessed Virgin. 65 I lay down again and my side started. The union with God was such || that the ribs were raised and my side was transported in God. Oh, sweet night! I woke up early and after the Holy Communion what I felt and how many things I asked for! What a union I felt! I saw the Holy Father who spoke much with the person who gave him good information on the Work; the dear sovereign Mary, my dear mother said to me:

You will have everything you asked for.

I turned and looked at St. Anne; 66 what a surprise! My eyes met hers and she was cheerful, she was not ash-pale; in the same way the Blessed Virgin was || beautiful.

Oh, my mother, therefore today you will give me strength and grace to toil for these creatures!

She assured me that I would bring them back. This did not delay to be verified. This evening the ass was able to speak. They already came to tell me frankly that they got nothing from the Spiritual Exercises but the last word which I said to them… Oh, throwing themselves at the feet of Jesus, they all asked for forgiveness and wanted to change! God had mercy on them!165

67 What goodness of my || dear, beloved Love, my sweetest Saviour! I wish to be able to describe the conversation I had on certain things which I desired to obtain. Oh, what sweetness and consolation!

I am not able to be at peace when I see certain very indifferent sisters! I feel much pain and I do not understand how they can be and live not caring. Oh, my Love, teach me what I should do to make you known and loved by these poor creatures.

Deprived of her spiritual notes.

Effects of obedience to which she was bound by a vow

I saw a big star that left me much suffering; who could it be? ||

68 I cannot describe the state in which my soul is in and the discouragement of my poor spirit. It makes me incapable of thought and of discernment. I am deprived of everything and am alone. In addition, he took away from me even those scribbles I had. Many times it was of much comfort for me to read what I wrote in certain moments of aridity and in other states and how I was freed. It was for me a great relief and I do not have even this. What horrible days, || what pains, arid of any relief! 69 From the guide I can have neither a word nor comfort, alone and under the most arid obedience. I feel strength but it is very imperceptible!

I also understand that it is the obedience to which I am bound strongly with a vow. What I feel is not something sensible as when one receives obedience verbally in every circumstance of need. || 70 I know everything is bound by this vow but it is a very strong sentiment, a strong action, and acting devoid of the least human relief.166

But this action is hard for me and makes as if the earth held no support for me, nothing that could relieve me. No, the miserable earth has nothing for me.

Limited time for prayer. “Work is my only companion”

71 The pains, the martyrdoms of these days are without equal. I feel so troubled as if I were pressed under a millstone. || Oh, pains, how much you oppress me!

They do not allow me to pray and to stay with my Good.

What a pain not to be able to pray!

I am still able to meditate and to contemplate; for the other prayers, what can I do? I cannot stand; I struggle but it is a cruel pain when I have to make an effort to do some of these. It is painful to see all praying to God.

72 Oh, my Love, this kind o f suffering is very deep! ||

In everything I see myself so ugly that I would hide underground in order not to be seen. I feel I must bore all who see me and tire all who speak to me. How much I suffer! I try not to see anyone and work is my companion. In it I stay from morning until evening and the way I am worn out I throw myself at the feet of my Beloved and I remain speechless. 73 I find nothing || to be able to release; how much I suffer, my Love! Every now and then I say one word but soon everything finishes and nothing is done with this poor and depressed spirit of mine. Oh, what agonies are these, my dear Love!

I always have a headache. For how can I remain indifferent? 74 Discipline does not help me. At the end this is a state I do not understand and I do not know how to find || the way to come out of it.

“Where is the Blessed Virgin Mary? She has also abandoned me and the same is for the Holy Mother”

I do not know if it is because of my not doing well what I do or if it is my sweet Love who keeps me in a dark cave alone, and it seems that I do not find the strength to come out: it is all dark.

75 The other night I had a few hours of union and my side was as usual but when this ended I was again down in the dark precipice where there is nothing but || suffering. Alas what days! Where is Blessed Mary? She has also abandoned me and the same is for the Holy Mother; it seems there is nothing more for me. Sufferings, not even you give me comfort as before. I bow under your weight, what a torture is this for me!

76 To think that before I found much pleasure in || suffering. This was a comfort to me and charity relieved me but not now. Everything is a grave burden and it seems to me that in a moment I will be crushed under such painful suffering. My God, what a torture!

Certainly, only the person who had experienced it can understand the gravity. How this ugly beast of hell roars! It cannot be described, everything it does to the work of the Lord! What an ugly monster! ||

77 Last night, tired as I was – it was midnight – I went to bed. How much it did to me! It tried to frighten me by all means and it succeeded because as I awoke by a shaking I saw a filthy animal that scrambled on the screen and I jumped from the bed. I looked – I said – it did it!

I remained very upset and later it continued with other things and always with its new inventions.

The work of God gains with tribulations

Unfortunately I understood there was something grave within me which happened today. Oh, how much and how many it studies! || 78 It must be always observing carefully but it will not succeed. No, no! God is with us, things which bring damage to the Work cannot happen because its Maker is very powerful and he lets things go so that it may always consolidate. 79 By now I feel no more fear, because every time that a grave inconvenience took place, the Work of the Lord had gained more because afterwards great things had followed. || In reality every time that something grave happens, I always say that the ugly monster sees that the

Work of the Lord will have great growth while it tries to oppose it. Oh, how ignorant it is!

80 Unfortunately in these days there were great tribulations, but Jesus, my sweet Love did not give up sustaining me with his lights and with his strength. Without this I cannot stand but in him everything is infinite. And everything that comes from him is great and immense. With him || everything can be resisted.

Oh, when the bones rise, the pain of my side is terrible but the delight is without compare. How could this mystery be explained? The stronger the pain and the suffering the greater the desire that it may increase and as the suffering increases the union becomes stronger. I remain absorbed in my Good tasting his sweet caresses.

81 Oh, Love, how || sweet is suffering! In your love how it is desired to be consumed in God and nothing comes anymore to mind. Everything is lost in the essence of your Love! Yes, my Good, in you everything is sweet and nothing more is desired to be consumed in you, my Good!

82 The battles are not yet concluded; I feel something in me that frightens me. I am always in a state of unrest; I understand nothing, see nothing except certain shadows that pass, who could they be? ||

Turmoil on all sides, first a shaking and then another; first small ones and then middle size. They are all different and they make me feel at one time nothing and at another time a gloomy pain that grips me and I have to force myself so that they may not realise. They give me something dismal. Other times they pass and I feel nothing. 83 I would not like other creatures || to experience this; they are painful things.

Today the anxiety increased and this evening is much stronger. In addition there is a blue star moving around me; it seems it needs something.

Oh, blessed soul, do you need prayers? I will not stop doing them, but they are useless. However, the bounty and the mercy of God accepts everything having pity on our miseries and on our nothingness. The gift of discovering what a person has in her/his heart

Oh, my Love, sweet Jesus! In these days I had the grace of seeing and distinguishing clearly what a person || had in her/his heart. 84 How clearly he made me see the things which are false and those which are true in what the sisters tell me and write to me! Oh, my Love, not only for the sisters but also for the people with whom I must speak. I cannot say how useful it is to work in a better way 85 in the Work of my

Good. Certainly much disorder is avoided and things are done with greater certainty. But not everything can be avoided, because || many times one cannot do it for lack of personnel as well as because of the distance, but my Good will take care.

I see a large providence soon to arrive. It seems to me always nearing. I cannot distinguish from where and who brings it to me, but I almost feel I possess it already. Oh, what a feeling!

“Alone, in the midst of a sea of suffering!”

86 Oh, how happy I would be if in these days in which I am in the midst of aridity I could be sure that my || Beloved is not displeased with me but he always loves me! Oh, what pains are these, when one sees everything vanish when much is done!

Jesus, my sweet Love, for pity’s sake take me out of this painful state which makes me suffer much. I am alone in the midst of a sea of suffering. It is something painful that I have no phrase to explain. 87 I feel disheartened that there are moments || in which I feel so mean and I see it so clearly that all the world, every creature, the most miserable one would be less mean than I. Oh, how poor my nothingness and less than nothingness! The humiliation that I feel is so strong that it does not allow me to stand up. 88 Only the toils of the ass which I carry on are able to distract me. Under the weight, in certain moments this toilsome work is a relief for me. || I carry it on with pleasure and I would like to have more strength to work in order to feel less this nothingness that disheartens me when I stop a minute to think of it.

But not, my Good, I am your ass; load over my shoulders whatever you want and give me the strength to run and carry it where it pleases you. But where are you, my Beloved?

89 The beautiful days have passed || and certainly I might have not worked well. That is why, alas, what a pain!

“To suffer without comfort is a real purgatory on this miserable earth”

Today I had a strong pain for having said a word which I feared might have caused an impression; but this evening, I am calm because my Good has promised me that he would assure me it was not true.

Oh, how much one suffers, my Good, only at the thought of having displeased you! For pity’s sake, let your right hand guide all my actions and words.

90 I had a few hours of real agony and this night I felt it starting again. I cannot explain what I felt. || The uproar that takes place in me is such that I cannot describe it. My God, my sweet beloved Love, only you could explain my state!

I see torturing things and feel sad; I cannot understand what it is; but when this takes place in me I feel deep pain such that I do not feel alive. I see dead people of every kind, the most horrible that could be on the earth.

91 Finally on all sides I feel and I see coming || tribulations without compare. I have no more courage to think; my mind is now here, now there but it is unable to understand anything. What a horrible state this is! To see a heap of afflictions and tribulations and not to understand what to do in order to halt them; it is really useless because it is the devil who does all. 92 When it finds its way blocked on one side, it tries the other side to see if it can || overcome. But my Good always allows it for a while but he soon comes to my help. My Beloved!

To suffer without comfort is a real purgatory on this miserable earth: without a word and abandoned in the deepest abyss. I always see small and big stars moving around me; I cannot distinguish what it could be, but from the anxiety that I feel they are good sisters who will bring me affliction. ||

93 I am able to have positive explanations on the behaviour of a superior who never said the things the way she thought them. She always had certain fringes and she was really a great risk to others. It was my Good who made me feel this, which she was… And how? Every time that she came before me a voice said to me:

Do not believe, she is… be careful, she deceives you!

94 But in spite of this, she carried || so well the things that I always feared. But not! My Good this morning after Holy

Communion… Oh, my Love! I was absorbed and what did

I experience, my Good, and how many beautiful lessons I had!

“I do not live, but I live in you and you are in me”

I feared certain things but everything vanished; I took courage and strength to work in the field of my Good. I am nothing other than his ass that tries to carry the load according to what my Good places on me. Today I was gifted with…

95 Yes – I go on saying || to myself – you will have no more doubt, no fears because you will receive everything with a serene spirit.

It really seems to me that nothing could knock me anymore, but it is not true because by now experience taught me that when I find myself in those moments in which I do not find my Good, what pains; and though I try to persuade myself that it will come to an end, since a thousand times it had happened like that, not at all! || 96 The loss and the suffering is such that I cannot avoid lamenting and feeling immense suffering. Nothing helps me to be convinced and to reason. No, and so many times the suffering increases when one wants to reason and find relief now from a word and then from these scribbles of mine. 97 Well nothing can calm, only the coming of the Beloved, who with a word, and with his closeness || makes us forget everything and one returns to live with the certainty that she could not return anymore to that state; that my Good will remain always with me and will never deprive me of his dear sweetness in suffering and in giving me lessons. 98 Yes, my dear Love, I live only for you and you live in me; it is not I who live but I live in you and you are in me. Oh, my sweet All! ||

Prophetesses and prophets who make mistakes in their predictions

How many prophecies they make and write to me but until now I saw to be true only one; because when Sister Anne del Salvatore was alive, how many I experienced and all were true. How sure she was in her speech, my dear Sister Anne del Salvatore! Oh, how many predictions she said and others she wrote 99 to me and all were true. But many other prophetesses and prophets I see that || my Good does not allow that they tell me the things as I know they are. Oh, how easy it is to make mistakes! It is really true that even the saints, if my Good does not allow them to see what passes in the mind of a person, what they have of prophecy and light is of no use. They only see what my Good allows them.

100 When we want to put our own stuff in the things of || God, then everything remains imperfect.

Signs of a true and false holiness

Oh, how beautiful it is to see certain dear souls who work in simplicity and know they have nothing! They only see their misery and with this they keep humble and walk certain. 101 But many times it depends on the guide; they realise that they held them as holy and when someone touches them, they defend || them and they listen to them. Instead of humbling them they exalt them. What fear I feel for them because soon they end up losing all the good and remain in the hands of pride. They lose the little good that they had acquired and create very high concepts of themselves that nothing can help to make them come back to themselves. Oh, how many facts of this kind I have seen. They make me shiver! || Oh, what a dread! 102 And in these days there are so many of these souls! I could narrate hundreds of facts that passed through my hands which I did not believe and I did this purposely. They were suspicious; they did not want to know anything and they grumbled and more so they were afflicted for the offences that they received. Oh, poor! By themselves they declared to be sinners… 103 but when || they realised that others took it to be true, then they came up with visions…

What times are we in, my God! The religious who are inclined to this state of life frighten me. The things that pass through my hands every day frighten me because I see that we are in times in which everything is pretence and vainglory;

they cover lies in a way that it is difficult || to discover them.

104 They are very astute that if it were not for the many experiences, I do not know how they could be discovered.

But mostly it is the help of my Good who in his divine light soon shows me the cloudy and the false. Though they try to bring the thing to the truth, at the same time their interior unrest is so clearly seen that one feels pity. 105 Oh, if I could || describe how my Beloved shows me this.

There are also those souls for whom everything they say of their interior life, they say with such simplicity that one would never like to miss listening to them, and they have peace and serenity of spirit. These could be knocked down or 106 crushed but they remain always happy and they are aware of their nothingness when they find someone who || listens and praises them as well as when they are blamed.

In this, they are seen rejoicing and full of gaiety and when they are praised they weep because they see always their nothingness and that is why they are afflicted thinking they are not known and that they deceive with their way of being. 107 They are filled with || a thousand thoughts of their nothingness! But there are very few of these.

A dark soul obstinate in her unwillingness to be converted

Last night I thought I was dying. The ugly monster started to torment me at half past twelve and ended this morning. How much it did! Only God could know the pains it caused me such that I remained without strength and I had to remain in bed more than usual until I could regain a bit of strength.

108 There is a continuous strolling of beasts and a dark soul like firebrand was at the back of the bed || as if indicating its stubbornness in being converted. Who could it be? I always prayed and asked what I should do; it was a painful suffering but it came to a conclusion. The poor soul seemed to say:

I will be damned.

I did not know what else I should do than pray; I also offered to my Good my few penances so that touched by his grace it may be converted.

109 At the end I did not know what to say and think who it could be. || I understood the sin because I had it in mind and even more as if I saw the sin it gave me horrible pain because I was not able to drive it away and it was always there. My God, they are horrible things, more terrible than ever!

Oh, my Good, for pity’s sake never allow me this horrid sight. What can I do? 110 Yes, I do pray and I feel much suffering. ||

In addition I was not able to distinguish the person. If I could have the obedience I would have liked to scourge myself until I obtained the grace but everything was limited and obedience did not allow me but very little. 111 In this way it always seemed to me painful. But I am happy to follow holy obedience which I love much. Oh, if my Good || will accept everything that I will offer to him, yes, I hope for the conversion.

Letters written under Jesus’ dictation

After Holy Communion my Good dictated to me a letter that I should have written to a Cardinal and this he did many other times. I would have never thought of doing that act but his Work required it for the good of the same. He notified me:

You will do this and the other.

In the same way, many times he dictated me letters to the administrations and how I should. 112 He showed me the advantage that || could come about. Have I not a reason when I say that I did nothing and feel ashamed and blush when they say something? Because the poor people think that I am good!

Oh, yes, to spoil, this one yes, because many times I do not understand well, since I am an ignorant who does not understand the sublime speech of my dear Master.

113 Because of my ignorance my Good || had to lower himself to dictate to me the letters. Oh, what I feel when he dictates and I hear such beautiful things. My Love, my sweet Master!

For some time I remain there and I seem to hear being repeated such beautiful things. How easy it is to dictate what has been learned!

“How sweet it is for a soul when it is forgotten by all!”

Today is Friday; I could say my meditation was of union and contemplation. I would always stay alone; how sweet is solitude!

114 In these days || I could say that for me there is only the night in which I can be alone. But during the day there is little time in the church where I am also disturbed because they came to search for me. Some days I am in the room but I can stay only one day in a week.

115 Oh, my Love, how painful it is in these moments in which I could stay always with you to be satisfied or at least to control the fire that I feel. But I must deny to the poor soul || even this and go to work in the midst of the field of God where an abyss if I can say of all the temporal things are treated.

Oh, what a pain! How sweet it is for a soul when it is forgotten by all and it is alone with the beloved! Oh, sweetness without compare! If all or at least certain good souls could taste it, how they could avoid any other conversation. Away parlor, away companions and fully taken to please her Beloved! Oh, my Love!

116 While I write this my ribs rise and a strong || fire burns me. Oh, my Love! Yes, make me always forgotten by all! This state is too sweet for me, my Love!

I could not think that the sweetness I feel in suffering in these days could be a reward. No, my Love, I suffer and it is true that I feel much comfort but this miserable body twists and bends under suffering.

The spirit is always ready to receive even more. Oh, my ribs, alas my side…

MS 5.5 – pp. 1- 36

The embrace of the Crucified detached from the cross

18 September 1885. 1 After having suffered much the previous day, a new type of suffering that exhausted me was added and I fainted. Oh, sweet suffering for my Beloved!

This morning of eighteen while I was at the feet of the altar to receive my Good, the Crucified came forward; he detached himself from the cross and embraced me. Oh, what I felt! Only you, my Love, could describe it because your sweetness is such that there will not be pens which could describe it.

2 I had a very dear day because I had much strength in suffering and I was fully resigned || as if there was nothing on earth for me that could comfort me or afflict me. What a sweet state! But this is nothing than a preparation for greater pains and tribulations. What days! What pains!

What sufferings! I saw clearly what could happen to an affair of the Work.

But the Holy Mother will take much care in this and her Institute will have greater honour.

It is true that I feel pain and anxiety, but I also feel and clearly see the victory. ||

3 The beasts continue to make noise and I also saw other small stars. I went to visit the sick and I saw one of these beautiful and very shining stars on the side in which one of them was close to heaven. Oh, how beautiful it was! Dear creature, what happiness you will delight to see your beloved Jesus! Oh, my Love, yes, she is an angel!

Impulse to start the Work of the Sons of St. Anne

How clearly I felt what I should do, where to put and remove the sisters, their transfer from one house to another.

4 Oh, how I suffer when I see that they do not correspond to the grace that the merciful Saviour grants them || and lavishes to the Daughters of St. Anne because he refuses nothing to his dear grandmother who obtains whatever she wills.

Yesterday night was one of suffering. I do not know what pain a beast left me. My Good, when will these finish tormenting me? Why do they not come during day time? Instead they come always at night leaving me worn out that in the morning I must struggle to stand on my feet!

5 I would like to write how I find myself at present in my painful state! I see that my Good || invites me always with a certain thrust and more so provides me with means to start the Work of the sons of St. Anne. But the enemy tortures me so much that only at the thought of this thing all the nerves make such a violent movement that I understand it is the work of the devil. It uses this miserable ass because it is destroyed and does not want to be subjected to new pains and overwork. 6 On the other side I see clearly the way and what I should do in order to start the Work, but the battle is || strong. What a battle!

Light and “instructions” regarding the novitiate

How my Love has taught me what I should do regarding the novitiate! What great and beautiful instruction he gave me in making novitiate after having tried them in the work of charity and in the service. He opens the way for me so that I may be more convinced that it is fully his will and I will certainly have much help in order to accomplish this.

7 Meanwhile I will do the trial and if it is successful I will speak up to obtain the approval. I do not doubt || that it will be of much help for the poor Institute and true servants of the Lord will be formed. Therefore, he desires that as soon as they are dressed they may be sent to experience the whole life of the nurses, the hospital and the rest. When it is seen that they do well they will be called and they would start the year of novitiate and this will help them well to grow in the life of perfection to become holy. After this they will return to the life of sacrifice and charity.167 ||

8 That is what my Good did. My head becomes big when my Good acts, suggests and prepares everything. Finally it is something very great and it cannot be expressed because great things are seen which are done by themselves; it is not seen physically but with the eyes of faith. It cannot be said differently from this because this working is great and perfect. My Love, consume me! ||

Beasts and flattering diabolic suggestions

9 The strolling beasts always continue. A very furious one came to fall upon my head, and it was very ugly; it left me much pain. I would have liked to understand something but it was not possible; I only understood which side it came from, now that I have learned through experience, it was from Rome. It was very filthy and from the anger it had it was clear it came to crush me and it disappeared in the wall. 10 Oh, ugly monster! It always comes to disturb the peace and it took more than an hour of sleep || which I needed to get a bit of strength; but what can I do? If this is what my Good wants, may his divine will be done, and I will always remain resigned in my dear and sweet Love, Jesus.

The beasts continue to stroll always; last night one had a very long and subtle tail that impressed me as when one feels affliction but in a way… Not at all! This devil when it puts the tail it is always something bad; how many things it does!

11 They are new things – it said to me, not this but the other || evening – if you agree only to a thought that is for me, even the smallest adhesion in consenting to what I tell you and believe that there is nothing bad about it…

Forcefully it wanted me to adhere to the thought of desiring what it said and it could have provided for me and showed me great things. My God!

Go away, ugly monster, away, I do not want either to see or to know, no, no!

Oh, if it could have obtained a simple thought, how it insisted and in which manner it insisted! 12 But I won. ||

I struggled much but I have won, and it made a terrible uproar, but I remained firm in my Good. After winning the battle I had a gift from my God. Oh, what a union! My side, my bones, what I felt, my Love!

My Good showed me that it was not the thought of consenting to what the ugly monster wanted to show me that could be of help to the Institute but that I would have much wealth! 13 He said much more alluring things and much more strongly || I renewed my protest, my God, my sweetest Love!

If this ugly monster would be satisfied for a thought of curiosity of seeing great things and it twisted them in a way that consenting I would do nothing but good, and it made an uproar to see if it could obtain it; what would be of this serpent if it could achieve that? Alas, unfortunately I saw clearly in what a deplorable state it reduced the souls through this means.

Unfortunately it shows and makes one feel and taste the things as if they were heavenly things.

14 A creature || that was possessed how much she saw! The devil also used this creature to make me foolish: what will I have? What will happen? What… the greatest things! But all exterior, all were with a dose of flattery that it did not require effort to understand the language of the devil. How many lies it puts together!

A poor mean creature the way I am… this ugly monster tried to delude me with great pictures and said a thousand things to this poor unfortunate.

Many of them will come true – it said.

Oh, how || it brought them well! 15 In order to be believed many things became true.

The souls swollen by spiritual pride

In spite of all these, my good never stopped to show me clearly that they were all diabolic suggestions and astuteness of hell. Many souls fall into grave sins and are lost because that spirit is never satisfied until they end up in perdition. In addition to this when they are able to be trusted by the confessors they swell in such an unbelievable way; then the evil spirit || possesses them.

16 Oh, how it helps them and makes them say what will happen! Alas, poor and unhappy, they stride nearing their perdition. The pride that in them reigns in a subtitle and unseen way controls them as a sovereign. Oh, how different it is for a soul who really possesses the gifts of God! Oh, humility can be seen in her and if by accident someone realises something she feels bitter; she hides and tries all she can to discredit herself. Here is the opposite! ||

17 I will always remember this fact: I heard from two souls that both wanted to be saints and they preached… A person who needed healing recommended him/herself to them. What happened? She/he was healed and these two questioned between themselves, because one said:

I am the one who performed the miracle!

The other one said:

No, it is I!

Therefore, poor unfortunates, these were two of those which I mentioned, being possessed and really that was their end. Oh, horrible thing! 18 The souls || who are truly saints who work by divine influence, how humble they are! And if they realise that through them has been obtained that, they try to hide the happening. They always shift, adapt in a way that they do not appear to be understood that through them dear Jesus was pleased to grant the grace they requested. 19 They find a thousand means to avoid all the appearances and they find pleasure only in being || despised.

My God, sweetest Love, why did you drive me to write this? Oh, certainly it will be useful for the good! Yes, my beloved crucified Love!

How much I would do to make these poor souls come back in themselves for in these days there are many! 20 I can say this because I know a good number of them and the pain I feel for not being able to turn them away from the path made me take the resolution not to see them anymore. It is easier to convert a sinner || than to obtain from them a change of path.

Vision of a child in swaddling clothes:

the Sons of St. Anne

28 September, eve of St. Michael. I saw for two good times a globe of fire in the midst of which as it opened there was a child in swaddling clothes. I cannot describe how it left me; I really spent a calm night and I was able to rest for the consecutive hours. The headache stopped and also the lifelessness I suffered; I always feel within me much peace and calmness of spirit.

21 My side also took part in such sweet vision and I still feel some kind of union. || What does it mean, my Good? Still in swaddling clothes? They are certainly the Sons of St. Anne.

I do not understand well this vision; I hope that my Good in his infinite goodness may make me understand; I merit nothing, burdened by demerits as I am, I know I merit nothing. Everything I have is yours, my Love.

Sisters who walk in uprightness in the way of the Lord

As usual, I see clearly in the Daughters of St. Anne what they think and certainly if they knew, many times they would not try to hide certain things that they really never think I could see. 22 Oh, my Love, what || strong pains to see the duplicity of a soul! Likewise it is good to see one that is simple, sincere and working with zeal, with no affectation, having a pure, clean not boastful thought for God. Everything is straight towards one goal, that is, her beloved Redeemer.

She always keeps her thought at the bow and toils so that the ship may run straight and move towards the desired city of heaven. 23 There she seeks her beloved and thinks of nothing else but of him. She does everything for him, || and to him she hands over everything. What sweetness to see these souls who know they have nothing of themselves but see everything in God and only in him they run this miserable journey of an unfortunate world.

All the confessors are good for them and why? Because they are not busy to know who they are and how they are.

They are only concerned about making a good examination and think of being in front of the court of God, detesting their sins and waiting for penance. 24 They hold tight at the feet of the Crucifix to receive || the absolution from the minister and that suffices without expecting him to say the things sweetly or roughly; they do not care about all these. Oh, in these days, the opposite happens frequently. What many of these poor creatures do is that if the confessor is not according to their liking they do not confess. I feel compassion for them!

Lively awareness of the Father St. Francis of Assisi

How sick I felt last night! But the filthy monster did not stop tormenting me. It strolled now this side and then the other side. 25 Towards four o’clock there were two big cypress trees which from the ground reached || the ceiling, one near the other. As usual they left me upset and melancholic. They seemed to me to be two people who work much for the

Institute. That is why I felt much pain.

Today my Good supplied me with more strength more than usual because I had to work much. In the afternoon, as soon as I entered the church for the benediction, what I felt! In an instant I was enraptured in my Good and I had such a lively awareness of my dear Father St. 26 Francis of Assisi. Oh, what a blessed moment; || it ended very quickly. Oh, my sweet Good!168

Healings made with subtle remedy to cover the miracle

Sunday 15 November 1885. A person was described as having a sickness that tormented her much and she did novenas to this and to the other saint. Weeping she narrated and described to me her sickness. While I listened to her, I saw or rather I felt something: that the sickness was caused by the enemy to 27 keep her humiliated, she had nothing other. I ordered the monster to go away and in this I saw clearly that the sick side was healed and || she was to feel nothing more.

However, the ugly monster refused to leave the body and wanted to remain on one leg, but could not!

I ordered it to enter into the body of a fierce animal, and I saw that it did.

This person exclaimed:

I have nothing more, I feel better!

She was beside herself, but she neither knew nor understood anything of all those orders. I just told her that her sickness was nothing; it was the action of the devil who wanted to upset her. 28 Unfortunately the creatures entrust themselves to the doctors and are subjected to terrible treatments; instead the sickness is not physical but || caused by the enemy. In these days, however people do not believe in this.

My dear daughter Sister Anne del Salvatore, what a faithful companion and how she answers me what I ask of her! How she comforts me!

To prevent others from understanding what my Good deigns to work through me (…) and other things, I try to cover everything by feigned remedies.169 How happy I am that my Good keeps hidden everything and that he helps me! Oh, Love, yes, with your help I will always do things in a way that they may never realise. ||

29 My Love showed me another sickness and with interior suggestions foretold guiding me to do whatever could bring advantage to that soul. Oh, how I feel always more mean seeing my nothingness! I am almost lost, such is my meanness. What mercy of a God towards a miserable creature! My Love, what could I ever do? I have nothing, only misery and corruption, but your goodness is without limits. In this way it will cover my misery.

30 I am so oppressed by || suffering that I do not trust my ass; in this way I must battle even with it.

Vision of the Child Jesus. Spiritual sufferings

On the night of Christmas, while I was absorbed in

God, the holy Child appeared to me very beautiful with his arms open towards heaven. I was very sad and immersed in terrible afflictions. Jesus left me serenity of spirit, much resignation, pleasure in suffering, full of courage with peace that seemed to have become insensible to everything. 31 There was nothing more that seemed to me painful; suffering was || immense delight.

But I did not delay to go back to the previous state. My

God, what suffering I feel! I cannot describe it. What I can say is that seeing myself being pitied in certain temporal tribulations which all see, within myself I go on saying –

What is this my Good? Nothing! It seems that if all the tribulations of the entire world could be upon me, they could do nothing in comparison to the spiritual sufferings.

32 Oh, suffering which has no names for identification! || One just suffers horribly and has not the minimum relief.

Penances for the soul of a prince

The soul of a prince170 which was still in purgatory asked me for a penance; with this he would have been relieved. I was to recite Our Father- Hail Mary and Glory with the hands under my knees for the whole novena of Christmas. I asked for permission saying that being in the novena or the Child if I could increase my penances. It was granted to me and in this way I also added this one. 33 On the last days I disciplined very much myself, changing the penance || because the pain in the hands was much and I was feeling faint.

How much the discipline until bleeding humbles me because there is nothing more than skin; but as for blood only a little clear drops come out. The same was for the other discipline I did; I woke up at night because if it was earlier I feared that they could hear me.

I would like to be able to describe the melancholy that I felt; it is terrible to be careful so that they may not realise. 34 My God there are moments in which it seems to me to be in agony, that my soul should have no more peace. It is so exhausted || though I always struggle, I fall back and I understand when many times they ask me what I have. Oh, my Love, you could tell what I have!

Beautiful argument with Sister Anne del Salvatore

The argument between me and Sister Anne del Salvatore was beautiful. I would have liked to see a healing through her but she refused. I said:

Well, yes, dear daughter, in the name of God, make this donkey see the grace you performed; that this creature may be healed, and the grace was done.

I laughed.

Oh, dear daughter, how curious, even in heaven you want || to stay hidden!

35 For this reason she did not want to appear and wanted the grace to be granted through my poor prayers.

Everything was covered, but the scene that took place in that moment…
